name: Blackflow Forest of the Sunken
line:
Beneath the Blackflow, within the forest, lies buried more than one secret.
Schemers and explorers come and go as they please, intruding upon this land and sinking into it.
Stay lucid, or you too will forever become one of them.

zones.name: Bolívar Skin Layer
zones.desc: Unexplored land offers itself up to a new master.

zones.name: The Sweet Wound
zones.desc: The blade cuts through, and original sin pours out mingled with sweetness.

zones.name: Crimson Hollow Vein
zones.desc: The moment Pure Gold bathes in sunlight, the whole land glitters.

zones.name: Victims' Humus
zones.desc: If the land cannot soothe Your wrath, then take my blood and bone.

zones.name: Cadejo's Skull
zones.desc: Some wounds never heal; some fury never subsides.

nodeTypes.name: Combat Ops.
nodeTypes.desc: Everyone has their weapons drawn. They're definitely not here to negotiate.
nodeTypes.func: A regular combat node. Win to earn rewards such as Collectibles and Originium Ingots.

nodeTypes.name: Emergency Ops.
nodeTypes.desc: Some violence may well exceed your expectations, a very common occurrence.
nodeTypes.func: A high-difficulty battle with stronger enemies than regular operations. The rewards (Hope, etc.) are better to match.

nodeTypes.name: Dreadful Foe
nodeTypes.desc: Villains, thugs, the cursed... You're in trouble.
nodeTypes.func: The boss battle guarding the end of a floor. You must clear it to proceed to the next floor.

nodeTypes.name: Rogue Trader
nodeTypes.desc: Not an ally, or an enemy. Some people like to sit on the fence.
nodeTypes.func: A shop where you can spend Originium Ingots on Collectibles and items, or restore Life Points.

nodeTypes.name: Safe House
nodeTypes.desc: Nobody will bother you here, and there's plenty of food and water. No need to be so tense all the time.
nodeTypes.func: A rest node offering upkeep options such as restoring Life Points or temporarily promoting Operators.

nodeTypes.name: Encounter
nodeTypes.desc: New friends, old rivals… Strange encounters never age. Only scars stand the test of time.
nodeTypes.func: A node where a random event occurs. Depending on your choice, you gain rewards or pay a price.

nodeTypes.name: Wish Fulfilled
nodeTypes.desc: There are many ways of making a wish, but the wish itself is almost always the same thing.
nodeTypes.func: A node where you pick one of several randomly offered Recruitment Vouchers.

nodeTypes.name: Lost and Found
nodeTypes.desc: The void of helplessness will be filled by the joy and satisfaction of gain.
nodeTypes.func: A node where you offer up what you have (Life Points, Collectibles, etc.) in exchange for other rewards.

nodeTypes.name: Scout
nodeTypes.desc: Someone will always have to take the first step, to show the way for those who come after.
nodeTypes.func: A node where you dispatch some of your Operators. Dispatched Operators leave your squad for a while and bring back rewards when they return.

nodeTypes.name: Wander into Wonderland
nodeTypes.desc: Branches on one side and leaves on the other, the unexplored land lies right next to you.
nodeTypes.func: An entrance that consumes Crafted Goods to enter the hidden zone 'Black Pool'. Utopia rules apply inside the Black Pool.

nodeTypes.name: Face-Off
nodeTypes.desc: A conversation between prey and hunter.
nodeTypes.func: A special battle where you choose your opponent. Losing doesn't cost Life Points, and tougher opponents give better rewards.

nodeTypes.name: Prophecy
nodeTypes.desc: The choice lies before us, the outcome already set.
nodeTypes.func: A story event node tied to ending branches. It appears at specific locations depending on your progress and inventory, and can lead to hidden ending routes.

nodeTypes.name: Prophecy
nodeTypes.desc: The choice lies before us, the outcome already set.
nodeTypes.func: A story event node tied to ending branches. It appears at specific locations depending on your progress and inventory, and can lead to hidden ending routes.

nodeTypes.name: Secluded Trader
nodeTypes.desc: Secrets and routes are set on the scales; as they sway, the price is fixed.
nodeTypes.func: A merchant of the secluded realm who trades in Parts (Natural Objects, Crafted Goods, Concepts).

nodeTypes.name: Winding Secret Path
nodeTypes.desc: A local masterpiece.
nodeTypes.func: A shortcut passage connecting distant points on the map, saving the Action Points spent on travel.

nodeTypes.name: Perilous Path's End
nodeTypes.desc: Merely the start of another quest.
nodeTypes.func: The final battle node that caps off the exploration.

nodeTypes.name: Perilous Bypass
nodeTypes.desc: Shh, don't tell anyone this secret.
nodeTypes.func: A side path that lets you slip past the boss battle without facing it head-on.

nodeTypes.name: Emergency Aid
nodeTypes.desc: You can never have too many hands—or too many friends.
nodeTypes.func: A node where you can receive temporary support during exploration.

nodeTypes.name: Feather's-Eye Lookout
nodeTypes.desc: What you see isn't what you get. Mark it down, and don't forget to plan your route.
nodeTypes.func: A lookout node that lets you survey and mark the surrounding terrain and nodes in advance.

nodeTypes.name: 'Resident' Stronghold
nodeTypes.desc: Their peaceful lives were shattered—no wonder they're seething with rage.
nodeTypes.func: A high-difficulty battle assaulting a 'Resident' Stronghold. Appears only at Classification Level 4 or higher.

nodeTypes.name: Forest Clearing
nodeTypes.desc: Nothing happening is the most touching kindness of all.
nodeTypes.func: An empty node where nothing happens—a waypoint to pass through while saving Action Points.

difficulties.name: Classification Level
difficulties.rule: Higher initial Max Life Points; on failure, gain 'Special Ops Footage' for the next run

difficulties.name: Classification Level
difficulties.rule: Some 【Perilous Path's End】 nodes are no longer revealed in advance

difficulties.name: Classification Level
difficulties.rule: 【'Resident' Stronghold】 nodes appear; failing no longer grants 'Special Ops Footage'

difficulties.name: Classification Level
difficulties.rule: Realtopia effects advance to the middle stage and spawn more often; Realtopia · Policy effects are added

difficulties.name: Classification Level
difficulties.rule: Lose 10% of your Originium Ingots when entering the next zone

difficulties.name: Classification Level
difficulties.rule: Deployment Limit -1; initial Max Life Points -2

difficulties.name: Classification Level
difficulties.rule: Realtopia effects advance to the late stage; each Realtopia affects a wider area

difficulties.name: Classification Level
difficulties.rule: Non-initial 5-star Operators cost +1 Hope; 'Bolívar, Core of the Crux' has increased DEF; 'Unquenched Land' also deals Burn Damage

difficulties.name: Classification Level
difficulties.rule: 'Hound Proto' loses 1 Action Point upon entering the objective; 'Source-Tier Cube' has increased Max HP, and once it activates, all friendly units lose HP every second

difficulties.name: Classification Level
difficulties.rule: Non-initial 6-star Operators cost +1 Hope; 'Hound Proto' has increased Max HP and restores HP to 'Cadejo, Source of the Blackflow' when attacking

difficulties.name: Practitioner List
difficulties.rule: Monthly Squad mode, refreshed on the 1st of each month

stages.name: Hound Pathogen
stages.desc:
Hounds are transformed from the sick they have mauled and devoured? How could you come up with such a terrible and far-fetched idea?
There is an <Originium Altar> on the field that damages both enemies and allies

stages.name: Forgotten Time
stages.desc: They say that in the Blackflow Forest even time is forgotten. You picked up a damp flint abandoned in the rainforest three days ago, and in the blink of an eye you saw the neon-dazzling night of a hundred years later.

stages.name: Impatience
stages.desc: Before the 'Residents' here can become warriors in their own right, they must walk a long journey. Building strength through endurance is their creed—so act immediately, and don't try to outlast them in patience.

stages.name: The Watering Sage
stages.desc:
Put up fences, then invite the sages onto the land to show off their talents. It's far more economical than using irrigation machines. Perhaps we can call this place a 'plantation.'
There are <Bush> tiles on the field that prevent allied units from being targeted by enemy ranged attacks

stages.name: Bug Arcade
stages.desc:
What is happening here has nothing whatsoever to do with that guy you know. Absolutely true. But if you realized which guy this is about, that means you still had your doubts, right?
There is a <Stress-Zero Helper> on the field that activates automatically after a while

stages.name: No Man's Land
stages.desc:
Civilization always begins with lighting a fire, and lighting a fire always begins with felling trees, so civilization always begins with felling trees. Some consider seizing living space from those less civilized to be a kind of morality.
Provides <Rhodes Island Temp Worker> who can clear <Giant Mushroom>

stages.name: True Nature
stages.desc: A Sarkaz mercenary invited me to go plunder a nearby village with him. I asked him why he didn't farm his own land. He flew into a rage, opened his gaping maw, and lunged at me.

stages.name: Far North Hunting Grounds
stages.desc: Some of the information swallowed by the hounds is reproduced in the Blackflow Forest. But who on earth brought these ferocious creatures to the far north of this land? Good heavens, they really will eat anything!

stages.name: Treetop Trap
stages.desc: Two brothers had their land seized, were driven from home, and became mercenaries. Years later they returned to their old home and assassinated the estate owner as he was about to climb a tree to take Fowlbeast eggs. In the end, cornered at a cliff's edge by pursuers, they took their own lives together.

stages.name: Budget Veto
stages.desc: Some agents ask us why the Columbian government can't allocate enough budget to flatten the Blackflow Forest with tanks and low-altitude aircraft. Well, this is why, you idiot.

stages.name: Survival Instincts
stages.desc: The most common sight here is an animal running wildly and smashing headfirst into a tree. Why won't they turn back? Sigh—why won't I turn back?

stages.name: Trailblazing March
stages.desc:
Some native Bolívarians saw ice for the first time from a traveling merchant, who said it came from a northern country. That country has another specialty, too—an army that can flatten everything.
There is <Rubble> on the field that can block enemy movement routes

stages.name: Looting the Fire
stages.desc: A gang of bandits had coveted this wealthy village for years, and today they finally succeeded—it turns out the Columbian army had knocked the door open for them.

stages.name: Scorched Home
stages.desc:
Fifty years ago, a group of Sarkaz proclaimed a patch of Bolívarian land to be Kazdel, and the pioneers who failed to seize it put it to the torch. Fifty years later, a new 'Kazdel' was born on the still-smoldering scorched earth.
There are <Heat Pump Passage> tiles on the field that intermittently damage units on them
Provides <Roadblock> that can block enemy movement routes once deployed

stages.name: Black Backflow
stages.desc: Once the Blackflow seizes you, it becomes like a countercurrent, eroding again and again the embankment you built from the experiences and time of your life, until it destroys them and carries them away.

stages.name: Glimpses of the Future
stages.desc: Someone in Bolívar shared what they had seen at a technology expo in Columbia. Upon hearing it, a journalist took up a pen and wrote: “In Columbia, people stripped of their land can only live in the sky.”

stages.name: Plantation Horror
stages.desc: Ten strong laborers went to work the fields; one became a black shadow, and then there were nine. Nine strong laborers went hand in hand to spread the manure; one sank into the Blackflow, and then there were eight...

stages.name: Picking Sides
stages.desc: The 'Residents' are voting on something. You don't understand their language and have no intention of interfering, but as you pass by, they all turn to look at you in unison.

stages.name: Birth Rite
stages.desc: “Do not disturb the sacred birth rite!” The officiants sternly stop you, and try to lift 'infants' one by one from the Blackflow. But you see it clearly: what lies in those swaddling clothes are unmistakably hounds.

stages.name: Violent Escort
stages.desc: Large quantities of equipment and devices are being transported deep into the Blackflow Forest. You shouldn't have seen this—at the very least, you shouldn't have let the escorts know you saw it.

stages.name: Night of the Long Knives
stages.desc:
On the eve of that failed operation, the remnants of the Singas rebel army made every preparation, determined to purge all who stood in their way and overthrow this foolish dynasty.
There is a <Saintess Statue> on the field that warns of avalanches; the avalanche warning value rises when enemies or allies enter its range

stages.name: Seized Homeland
stages.desc:
Why is it that only humans seem to get lost in the jungle? Because before they learn the way, humans cut the whole jungle down—it's not their home anyway. You say the jungle had inhabitants to begin with? Really?
There are <Thicket> and <Shield and Wall> on the field that block line of sight

stages.name: Just One Step Away
stages.desc:
The seventh time you pass the same signpost, you finally find an exit between two trees. Unfortunately, they suddenly stand up and run off, and you can't catch up no matter how hard you try.
There are <Thicket> and <Shield and Wall> on the field that block line of sight

stages.name: Greed Blots Out the Sky
stages.desc:
“This place is filled with endless greed!” After experiencing the customs of Dossoles, a traveler from Sargon summed up the crux of all the disasters on this land in a single sentence.
There are <Bush> tiles on the field that prevent allied units from being targeted by enemy ranged attacks

stages.name: Malicious Wage Demands
stages.desc: A group of tournament knights organized a massive strike over working hours and pay. A few weeks later, hound futures prices skyrocketed; a few months later, Kazimierz had a new, thriving cemetery.

stages.name: Farewell Ceremony
stages.desc:
The remnants walk slowly around their companion's grave mound, carrying the soul away piece by piece until the grave collapses and turns to dust. Only then can the departed attain eternal peace.
There is <Active Originium> on the field that makes units continuously lose HP but greatly increases their ATK and ASPD

stages.name: Where the Water Is Wine
stages.desc:
You're saying Iberia is all salt deserts like this, where people can't get coffee and can only drink salty scale juice? No wonder they traveled all the way to Bolívar to play the unwelcome intruders.
There are <Saltheap Cannon> on the field that can fire shells and launch enemies

stages.name: Law of the Jungle
stages.desc: Under such a law, every single wild animal, plant, and human on this land believes only that it must wipe out two or even three of the others. What a barbaric way of thinking.

stages.name: Overbreeding
stages.desc:
Old José's ninety-seventh grandchild was born, and the father desperately held the child up before the grandfather. But the old man had long since lost his sight and speech, and nothing inheritable remained on his pitiful estate.
There is a <Mobile Tactical Hangar> on the field that launches enemy mercenary drones

stages.name: Shared Fate
stages.desc: I will nourish this land with my blood, and fill your flesh and blood with my own—so long as you do not forget that you once shared the same name.

stages.name: Coexistence
stages.desc: I will surely find that golden plain from my dreams. I will forget the gray-black cement, the scorching afternoon sun, and the oars on the shore from more than three hundred years ago. We will no longer create nouns to divide one another. We coexist.

stages.name: Grand Opening
stages.desc: This bag-carrying bear finally has its own security company. It proudly shoulders that familiar big bag as it inspects its security squad, eliminating every safety hazard on site.
stages.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new enemies will appear

stages.name: Partners' Meeting
stages.desc: This duck can work with any creature, living or dead—rumor has it he even once joined forces with that general. After all, that's how commercial empires prosper.
stages.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new enemies will appear

stages.name: Nightmare in the Lake
stages.desc:
You were dragged down into the lake. The flowing Pure Gold and sorrowful tears burned your hands, carving a fable about 'greed.'
There is a <Detector> on the field that can detect invisible enemies
stages.eliteDesc: Enemies gain increased ATK, DEF, and HP; new enemies will appear

stages.name: The Iron Fist Myth
stages.desc:
The Blackflow Forest remembers everything this general did—his iron fist, his swift and decisive ways—yet it lost only the fragments of his late-night musings: the futures he imagined, which Bolívar could never realize.
There is a <Mobile Tactical Hangar> on the field that launches enemy mercenary drones

stages.name: Mourning the Iron Fist
stages.desc: The mourners formed a long procession. They saw a true unifier, a false traitor, a man who could not be judged, a... Bolívarian.

stages.name: Glorious Expedition
stages.desc:
At first, this great explorer merely discovered a bountiful land and 'took what each needed' with the local natives here. As for how the land was developed—cover your ears and you won't hear the cannon fire; close your eyes and you won't see the slaughter.
There are <Saltheap Cannon> on the field that can fire shells and launch enemies

stages.name: Pure Gold Misfortune
stages.desc:
Ever since explorers discovered this land, the same thing has kept happening: losing so-called 'useless things,' gaining a brief prosperity, and waiting for night to fall—the butterflies of the night do not bring misfortune, but Pure Gold does.
There is an <Originium Jetstream> on the field that blows out airflow

stages.name: Fervent Devotion
stages.desc: This scholar from Singas poured every bit of wealth he had gathered from this land into researching the secrets of Originium. He wished to reverently present his experimental results to the Hohenzollerns, yet never even caught sight of the steps to an audience.

stages.name: Cold Exile
stages.desc:
This scholar was not Bolívarian, much less Leithanien. He drifted all the way to Columbia carrying his research, and unexpectedly inspired another genius. Only thus was his name able to return to his homeland.
There is an <Imprisonment Device> on the field that can Stun enemies

stages.name: Never at Peace
stages.desc: It has already descended, like a black sun, roaring and devouring everything. Do you not hear it? Can you truly not hear it?

stages.name: Pain Shall Subside
stages.desc: Nothing here lasts except pain and chaos. It has already heard, it has already shared the burden, it has already fallen.

stages.name: Chaotic Source-Tier Theory
stages.desc:
This is a cage of possibilities. No one knows what will happen once these devices are activated, but she will do everything she can to ensure the outcome does not stray from her expectations.
<Source-Tier Cube Module> that allies can heal will appear on the field

stages.name: Malformation
stages.desc:
They should never have appeared, yet they already exist—the scars they branded onto the land of Bolívar will never heal, and covering them up only makes them more conspicuous and painful.
There are <'Decrepit Hulk'> on the field where Ranged Operators can be deployed

stages.name: Revenant of the Blood Night
stages.desc:
The head of a family, killed by his own subordinate on a rainy night, returns on a night of red rain with his dead murderer at his side. Now you too have learned this tale from the mouths of hounds. Good luck.
When <'Blood Debt Ledger'> progress reaches its maximum, 'Reckoning Time' begins

stages.name: Plush Games
stages.desc: Dolly only hoped the explorers' experience wouldn't be too terrible. He never expected that they would still flee in a panic at the sight of fluffy creatures. The game's value was greatly diminished, and he was very sad.

stages.name: No Escaping Fate
stages.desc: For a moment, you can't tell whether the hounds are more terrifying, or the Abnormal Manglerbeast before you has the edge. The only thing you're sure of is that you don't want to mutate just yet.

stages.name: A Friend of Baa
stages.desc:
Both of them are creatures with horns on their heads and fluff on their bodies, yet the hornbeast can't understand why it doesn't understand what that hopping fellow is saying. Still, its body instinctively follows the other on a stroll.
Provides <Roadblock> that can block enemy movement routes once deployed

stages.name: Bared Fangs
stages.desc:
Hatred is the language of wolves; standing united against outsiders is the foundation of solidarity.
There are <Bush> tiles on the field that prevent allied units from being targeted by enemy ranged attacks
When <'Blood Debt Ledger'> progress reaches its maximum, 'Reckoning Time' begins

stages.name: No Favorites
stages.desc:
Failing to tell friend from foe is the beginning of civilization's fall. As for where it ends, the dead do not speak.
There are <Defensive Barricade> on the field that block enemies

stages.name: 'Rowdy Revels'
stages.desc:
Dolly decided to join this not-quite-lively-enough party. No reason—just because he likes it.
Provides <Steam Soda Bottle> that releases pure white steam around it when destroyed

stages.name: 'Unbridled Fury'
stages.desc:
Zaro decided to join this not-quite-bloody-enough battle. No reason—just out of rage.
There is a <Command Terminal> on the field that deducts Life Points when destroyed

stages.name: 'Body's End'
stages.desc: This creature that has lost its reason decided to join this not-quite-miserable-enough gathering. No reason—just to survive.

stages.name: Dead Branches
stages.desc:
The dead awaken and grow anew here.
There is <Active Originium> on the field that makes units continuously lose HP but greatly increases their ATK and ASPD
There are <Twigs That Crave> on the field that spawn Rot Eaters

stages.name: Rotting Leaves
stages.desc:
The living remain here in an endless sleep.
There is <Active Originium> on the field that makes units continuously lose HP but greatly increases their ATK and ASPD
There are <Twigs That Crave> on the field that spawn Rot Eaters

stages.name: Forced Deals
stages.desc: The 'Residents' here have no idea how to refuse the machines' sales pitches. Food and drinks pop out of tin cans on their own, yet the 'Residents' are required to pay for them.

stages.name: Forced Deals
stages.desc: The 'Residents' here have no idea how to refuse the machines' sales pitches. Food and drinks pop out of tin cans on their own, yet the 'Residents' are required to pay for them.

stages.name: Forced Deals
stages.desc: The 'Residents' here have no idea how to refuse the machines' sales pitches. Food and drinks pop out of tin cans on their own, yet the 'Residents' are required to pay for them.

stages.name: Advance and Retreat Converge
stages.desc: The ocean offers enough space for living things to evolve, while the forest holds enough species to complete the food chain and slow their degeneration.

stages.name: Advance and Retreat Converge
stages.desc: The ocean offers enough space for living things to evolve, while the forest holds enough species to complete the food chain and slow their degeneration.

stages.name: Advance and Retreat Converge
stages.desc: The ocean offers enough space for living things to evolve, while the forest holds enough species to complete the food chain and slow their degeneration.

stages.name: Deathmatch
stages.desc:
Twin Bolívarian brothers fought on the plains for three days and three nights without a victor, all to claim their mother's inheritance. But no one ever learned whether the winner was the elder or the younger—people only remember that the victorious Perro waved a bloodstained handkerchief and vanished at the far end of the plains.
Choose an opponent to battle. Defeat does not deduct Life Points; defeating harder opponents within the time limit yields better rewards

stages.name: Fighting Together
stages.desc:
There must be a reason this primitive, barbaric form of entertainment has survived to this day. Blood excites living things; death sobers them.
Choose an opponent to battle. Defeat does not deduct Life Points; defeating harder opponents within the time limit yields better rewards

stages.name: Strange Companions
stages.desc: A heartbroken dog walks along, crying. Luckily it has plenty of companions, so it won't be lonely on the way home—“Are you lost too?”

stages.name: Futile Autopsy
stages.desc:
While death was still digging through the soil for names, they exhumed an entire family from the graves, trying to find the root cause of the deformity—and found nothing. Back then, nothing had a name, and nothing had a cause.
When <'Blood Debt Ledger'> progress reaches its maximum, 'Reckoning Time' begins

stages.name: Security Measures
stages.desc: This wealthy merchant was fed up with being robbed again and again, so he learned a clever trick from that 'President'—find a body double!

stages.name: Grand Opening
stages.desc: This bag-carrying bear finally has its own security company. It proudly shoulders that familiar big bag as it inspects its security squad, eliminating every safety hazard on site.

stages.name: Partners' Meeting
stages.desc: This duck can work with any creature, living or dead—rumor has it he even once joined forces with that general. After all, that's how commercial empires prosper.

stages.name: Nightmare in the Lake
stages.desc:
You were dragged down into the lake. The flowing Pure Gold and sorrowful tears burned your hands, carving a fable about 'greed.'
There is a <Detector> on the field that can detect invisible enemies

stages.name: Death Box
stages.desc:
To capture the curiosities of the Blackflow Forest, an eccentric merchant who travels the land left many specially marked boxes among the trees. There is always some unwitting investigator who opens one, only to end up as a puddle of sludge beneath the tentacles.
After breaking a <Kannot's Safe>, deploy an Operator to pick up the reward inside to obtain goods from the Rogue Trader

stages.name: Living Wood
stages.desc:
An eccentric merchant who travels the land hid his treasure chests deep in the woods, waiting for the tree roots to swallow them and grow more chests—while the greedy and the overly curious pry the chests open and turn themselves into fertilizer for the woods.
After breaking a <Kannot's Safe>, deploy an Operator to pick up the reward inside to obtain goods from the Rogue Trader

enemy_2001_duckmi.name: Duck Lord
enemy_2001_duckmi.desc: A famous Columbian investor, entrepreneur, and master of 'Duck Power.' Out of the public eye, enjoys kicking back with others...
enemy_2001_duckmi.ability:
Cannot be blocked.
Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after being attacked

enemy_2085_skzjxd.name: Fatty
enemy_2085_skzjxd.desc: Duck Lord's associate and apprentice, an opportunist with a slick tongue. Frequently appears on dubious TV shows, preaching about how he cares little for losses or gains, as they are part of the natural money-making process.
enemy_2085_skzjxd.ability:
Always faces the direction with the most Operators.
Takes 80% less Physical/Arts damage from the front.

enemy_2002_bearmi.name: Gopnik
enemy_2002_bearmi.desc: The Ursus security guard hired by Duck Lord. Powerful, but not very smart. Mainly responsible for carrying luggage for Duck Lord.

enemy_2034_sythef.name: Crying Thief
enemy_2034_sythef.desc: A Perro who left his family to seek out a new life... but all that people know is that he is always weeping.

enemy_2152_shezlc.name: Wicked Cagewort
enemy_2152_shezlc.desc: A strange carnivore found in the Blackflow Forest, often mistaken for a plant. The scent given off by the special aromatic substance in its hunting sac makes prey think of things they love—known examples include, but are not limited to, hot dogs, cake, banknote ink, and Originium Ingot polish. Some collectors are willing to pay a high price for this substance.
enemy_2152_shezlc.ability: Steals a certain amount of Originium Ingots after entering the Protection Objective

enemy_2133_shdopl.name: Null Entity
enemy_2133_shdopl.desc: They are not yet ready to become 'Residents.' They yearn to embrace a particular form of life, seemingly because they were once given some kind of flaw. Paradoxically, the more they yearn, the more they realize that those forms were never theirs—only the flaw truly belongs to them.
enemy_2133_shdopl.ability: Initially disguised as another unit; reveals itself after taking damage

enemy_1034_laxe.name: Butcher
enemy_1034_laxe.desc: An enemy of unknown identity who wears white industrial overalls and attacks with a massive blunt object. Their appearances and combat style readily reminds people of those serial killers from movies, hence their nickname - Butcher.

enemy_1085_sotiwz_3.name: Mercenary Sarkaz Caster Leader
enemy_1085_sotiwz_3.desc: A Sarkaz Caster mercenary loyal to Talulah. The Sarkaz ritual maintained by the Sarkaz Originium Altars will not damage them, instead strengthening their bodies and converting their attacks into Arts damage.
enemy_1085_sotiwz_3.ability:
Casts Arts periodically, dealing Arts damage equivalent to unit's ATK to all surrounding units
When coming into contact with a Pulse Wave, this unit instead takes no damage and their attack range expands

enemy_3001_upeopl.name: Ursus Civilian
enemy_3001_upeopl.desc: An ordinary Ursus citizen caught in the crossfire. A part of the cruelty and suffering of this world.
enemy_3001_upeopl.ability:
Does not deplete Life Points when spared, but will deplete a Life Point upon dying
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter

enemy_2137_shsdgo.name: Hound Proto
enemy_2137_shsdgo.desc: After being born from the mother body, their forms were twisted by machines, their wills twisted by Arts, and their souls twisted by Originium. Then, dragging their diseased bodies and carrying the breath of all living things, they returned to the mother body. From then on, those twisted curses accompany them from birth, and are then scattered across the whole land.
enemy_2137_shsdgo.ability:
Attacks additionally deal <$ba.dt.rampage>Frenzy Damage</>
Periodically latches onto a unit and bites it continuously, greatly reducing the target's Physical and Arts attack hit rate

enemy_10113_ymgung.name: Raiton Ninja
enemy_10113_ymgung.desc: A ninja who loves technology, wielding a kendama-shaped flash drive as a weapon. Unbound by anyone, they leap to avoid danger.
enemy_10113_ymgung.ability: Briefly takes off when colliding with <'Certain Fates'>, blocked, or encountering a Hole.

enemy_1093_ccsbr.name: Tiacauh Warrior
enemy_1093_ccsbr.desc: One of Acahualla's most commonly-seen warriors who uses a crude spear to attack. May pose unexpected difficulties if fighting at close range.

enemy_1095_ccripr.name: Tiacauh Fanatic
enemy_1095_ccripr.desc: A fervent Tiacauh warrior with very fast attack speed. Though each strike is not particularly powerful, those caught off guard will be quickly subdued by a rain of blows.
enemy_1095_ccripr.ability: Every attack reduces the enemy's DEF

enemy_10081_mpplai.name: Decode Basis α
enemy_10081_mpplai.desc: Unknown entity born in the Abyss. It is passive if not attacked, but appears to be studying our movements.
enemy_10081_mpplai.ability:
Does not initially attack; transforms into different forms when certain conditions are met
Transforms into different forms once it has taken 4 Physical attacks, 4 Arts attacks, or if it is blocked

enemy_10073_mpcar.name: Confused Maintenance Helper
enemy_10073_mpcar.desc: Maintenance Helper whose pathfinding module has been disrupted by Originium. The meal delivery function added by the Engineering Department no longer works. 'You want a repair function? Look, we've already got plenty of engineers. As for Warfarin's food safety warning, we're working on it.'

enemy_10077_mpbarr.name: Mockup Auto Meal Distributor
enemy_10077_mpbarr.desc: Cafeteria meal distributor that is still in beta testing. A busy operator had the bright idea to attach a maintenance helper to it—to save the effort of walking from the dorms to the cafeteria—but the timing of the test was unfortunate to say the least.

enemy_2134_shrshep.name: Water-Hymn Sage
enemy_2134_shrshep.desc: Devout 'Residents' living in the Blackflow Forest. They are always happy to 'baptize' everyone they meet, seemingly because their village once suffered a long drought after outsiders cut off the river upstream—until, through the revelation of some deity, they learned this Arts.
enemy_2134_shrshep.ability:
Attacks additionally deal <$ba.dt.rampage>Frenzy Damage</>
Teleports a certain distance backward when attacked

enemy_1024_mortar.name: Mortar Gunner
enemy_1024_mortar.desc: One of Reunion's special ranged soldiers. Equipped with pilfered military-grade Originium launchers, they launch explosive attacks from hard-to-defend positions, making them a significant threat to back-line Operators.
enemy_1024_mortar.ability:
Capable of extremely long ranged-attacks
Shells deal area damage to target and any allied units in the surrounding 8 tiles

enemy_1024_mortar_2.name: Mortar Gunner Leader
enemy_1024_mortar_2.desc: One of Reunion's special ranged soldiers, more dangerous than a normal Mortar Gunner. Equipped with pilfered military-grade Originium launchers, they launch explosive attacks from hard-to-defend positions, making them a significant threat to back-line Operators.
enemy_1024_mortar_2.ability:
Capable of extremely long ranged-attacks
Shells deal area damage to target and any allied units in the surrounding 8 tiles

enemy_1246_aslime.name: Blackwater Originium Slug
enemy_1246_aslime.desc: A wild infected creature that normally lives in the nomadic city's sewers, it has surfaced after being provoked. It emits an unpleasant odor, but what's more vexing is that no one knows where they will pop up from next.

enemy_1246_aslime_2.name: Blackwater Originium Slug α
enemy_1246_aslime_2.desc: A wild infected creature that is more dangerous than a normal Blackwater Originium Slug. It normally lives in the nomadic city's sewers, but has surfaced after being provoked. Both its striking odor and its elusiveness often catch people off-guard.

enemy_1021_bslime.name: Infused Originium Slug
enemy_1021_bslime.desc: An infected wild creature that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen, exploding upon death. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.
enemy_1021_bslime.ability: Death deals a large amount of Physical damage to surrounding units

enemy_1067_snslime.name: Infused Glacial Originium Slug
enemy_1067_snslime.desc: An infected wild creature native to colder environments that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen. Upon death, they will explode and freeze nearby Operators. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by Yeti Squadron members for various tactical purposes.
enemy_1067_snslime.ability: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and applies <$ba.cold>Cold</> to affected targets

enemy_1352_eslime.name: Radioactive Originium Slug
enemy_1352_eslime.desc: A wild Infected creature that accidentally consumed too much industrial waste, causing it to leak Arts energy upon death. These low-intelligence creatures are easily manipulated by enemy casters to launch swarming attacks on manmade facilities.
enemy_1352_eslime.ability: When defeated, deals heavy Arts damage in an area and causes all enemies on the field to gain 1 Energy.

enemy_1067_snslime_2.name: Infused Glacial Originium Slug α
enemy_1067_snslime_2.desc: An infected wild creature native to colder environments that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen. More threatening than normal Infused Glacial Originium Slugs, they explode upon death, damaging and freezing nearby Operators. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by Yeti Squadron members for various tactical purposes.
enemy_1067_snslime_2.ability: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and applies <$ba.cold>Cold</> to affected targets

enemy_10119_ymgbxm.name: Stress-Relief Helper
enemy_10119_ymgbxm.desc: Punching robot used for stress relief by gang members. It would very much like to be on the punching side for once. The gang members who use it do not know that their stress has simply been transferred from human to robot, and it will return the favor someday.

enemy_10003_trwlpl.name: Raging Slug Eater
enemy_10003_trwlpl.desc: A lab-bred insectivorous plant. Due to mutations from a wrong nutrient fluid used by accident, it can now prey on more than just insects.
enemy_10003_trwlpl.ability: Devours a surrounding unit but requires an extended period to digest on the spot before devouring again.

enemy_1094_ccspm.name: Tiacauh Impaler
enemy_1094_ccspm.desc: Not much different from a regular warrior, except they've learned to throw their spears. Though their range is limited, they get the job done.

enemy_1097_cclmbjk.name: Tiacauh Shredder
enemy_1097_cclmbjk.desc: One of Zumama's chosen elites, bestowed with excellent equipment. In addition to being potent in combat, they have the ability to destroy terrain in order to seize the advantage. Those who seek to use long-range attacks against them will have to diversify their tactics.
enemy_1097_cclmbjk.ability: After several attacks, destroys Giant Mushrooms and Stumps, rendering them unable to be deployed upon

enemy_1022_dmage.name: Sarkaz Caster
enemy_1022_dmage.desc: A mercenary from Sarkaz. They use complex Arts to attack. Proceed with caution.
enemy_1022_dmage.ability: Uses chains to paralyze allied Operators.

enemy_1072_dlancer.name: Sarkaz Lancer
enemy_1072_dlancer.desc: A Sarkaz mercenary. After special training, they are capable of rushing forward with a long spear, building up speed. The faster they charge, the harder they strike anyone who might stand in their way.
enemy_1072_dlancer.ability: Gradually accelerates when moving, and deals additional damage on the first attack after being blocked based upon Movement Speed.

enemy_10079_mpmage.name: Stable Sarkaz Caster Crystal
enemy_10079_mpmage.cn: 稳定态萨卡兹术师结晶
enemy_10079_mpmage.desc: Originating from an archived enemy. The Originium body of these Sarkaz casters has induced unknown changes to the Arts they use, which may pressure our defenses.
enemy_10079_mpmage.ability: Temporarily halts your DP regeneration shortly after it enters the battlefield

enemy_1073_dscout.name: Sarkaz Sentinel
enemy_1073_dscout.desc: A Sarkaz mercenary. They are responsible for scouting, patrolling, and issuing early warnings to the entire squad. Once attacked, the Herald will immediately issue a warning that Inspires the entire army, shifting allied Sarkaz on Standby into Combat-Ready mode.
enemy_1073_dscout.ability: When injured, issues an alarm to immediately enhance the ATK and DEF of all enemy units, and makes enemies in Standby immediately enter Combat-Ready mode

enemy_1075_dmgswd.name: Sarkaz Bladeweaver
enemy_1075_dmgswd.desc: A Sarkaz mercenary. The Originium flowing through their blood allows them to hold these crudely modified Arts-imbued greatswords. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they are capable of dealing melee attacks that inflict Arts damage while in Combat-Ready mode.
enemy_1075_dmgswd.ability: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and inflicts Arts damage with melee attacks.

enemy_1501_demonk.name: Sarkaz Centurion
enemy_1501_demonk.desc: One of Reunion's squad leaders who also serves as a Sarkaz mercenary. He leads a group of Sarkaz mercenaries to fight on the front lines. Based upon the limited intel available, he is extremely tight-lipped, thus making it unlikely to get any information from him.

enemy_10126_rkbomb.name: Abnormal Originium Slug
enemy_10126_rkbomb.desc: These Originium slugs have mutated due to the environmental changes in the mines, caused by an unknown substance. Approach with care, as they are highly unstable.
enemy_10126_rkbomb.ability:
More likely to be attacked by friendly units; takes less damage, and deals Arts damage to the attacker when attacked
Loses abilities after being attacked several times by <Miner Guerrillas>

enemy_1108_uterer.name: Ursus Mangler
enemy_1108_uterer.desc: A warbeast trained by the Ursus Army. Obedient and relentless, they tear through armor with ease to sate their thirst for flesh and blood.

enemy_10065_ftzlc.name: Cabbage Seedling
enemy_10065_ftzlc.desc: A small, common fae, the original form of Patrolling Foliage. Completely harmless if separated from fire.
enemy_10065_ftzlc.ability:
Can be ignited by <Burning Vine> or <Burning Wick>
When defeated while ignited, deals a large amount of Arts damage to surrounding units

enemy_10067_ftsjc.name: Burning Vine
enemy_10067_ftsjc.desc: Passionate fae, the fire in its heart like a torch under a strange arch. The flowers and vines wrapping around it are merely decorative.
enemy_10067_ftsjc.ability:
Attacks inflict additional <$ba.dt.burning>Burn</>
ATK continuously increases before its first attack, and the first attack deals a large amount of Arts damage and <$ba.dt.burning>Burn</> to the target and surrounding units

enemy_10064_ftyzss.name: Patrolling Foliage
enemy_10064_ftyzss.desc: Withered stump possessed by a fae spirit. Not yet able to protect others, it roams only to protect its own dwelling. Reveals its true form when approached.
enemy_10064_ftyzss.ability: Their true nature is revealed when inside the attack range of your units

enemy_10066_ftxjl_2.name: 'Cradle'
enemy_10066_ftxjl_2.desc: Fae disguising itself as a fowlbeast nest. A cradle, just the right temperature... and 'hatchlings' breaking from their shells?
enemy_10066_ftxjl_2.ability: Grows when outside your units' Attack Range, increasing its ATK and Max HP

enemy_2135_shkrbt.name: Wind-Listening Hunter
enemy_2135_shkrbt.desc: Active 'Residents' living in the Blackflow Forest. They fanatically practice a hunting technique for tracking enemies, seemingly because their village was once plowed into ruins by invaders' sky-blotting bombardment—until a master assassin among them grasped this art.
enemy_2135_shkrbt.ability: Teleports next to the attacker when attacked

enemy_1263_durbus.name: Fully-Enclosed Beach Buggy
enemy_1263_durbus.desc: A beach buggy beloved by all. Carries three passengers in addition to the driver. Cool and breezy on the inside, it's perfect for those tuckered out from playing.
enemy_1263_durbus.ability:
Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
When next to enemies that are both non-Machine and non-Leader, they will be loaded inside as passengers (up to 3 max), and will be unloaded when this unit is defeated

enemy_1347_fyshp_2.name: Fashion Street 'Hyperactive Aviator'
enemy_1347_fyshp_2.desc: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the aviation shop. It can fly, but it's not very good at it. However, it's learned to float around in a group, filling the sky with soft clouds and interrupting the people's leisurely sunbathing.
enemy_1347_fyshp_2.ability:
<$ba.float>Low-Altitude Hovering</>
Can stack with a Fashion Street 'Robust Heavy' and is capable of long-range attacks after combining

enemy_1345_tplamb_2.name: Fashion Street 'Robust Heavy'
enemy_1345_tplamb_2.desc: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the sports field. It'll be really happy if you throw its 'treasure' back at it. Wait, no! It seem to be holding discuses this time!
enemy_1345_tplamb_2.ability: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

enemy_1263_durbus_2.name: Competitive-Grade Beach Buggy
enemy_1263_durbus_2.desc: A beach buggy beloved by all. Though its capacity is the same, all its other peripherals have been upgraded - in particular, the AC unit that effortlessly makes driver and passengers alike shiver.
enemy_1263_durbus_2.ability:
Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
When next to enemies that are both non-Machine and non-Leader, they will be loaded inside as passengers (up to 3 max), and will be unloaded when this unit is defeated

enemy_1309_mhboar_2.name: Raging Direswine
enemy_1309_mhboar_2.desc: A variety of Direswine extremely easy to anger, they dominate areas near water sources with great swagger. If one is enraged, it will indiscriminately rampage about with a madness sufficient to lay anything in the vicinity low.
enemy_1309_mhboar_2.ability:
Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
Gradually accelerates when charging, dealing damage based on Movement Speed to any target it passes through or is blocked by

enemy_1307_mhrhcr_2.name: Gravorobeast
enemy_1307_mhrhcr_2.desc: A Basorobeast subspecies particular to certain regions. Regimens of knocking into cliff rock since infancy have honed their heads to exceptional sturdiness, able to shrug off fierce frontal attacks. Survival never ends, and the struggle never ceases.
enemy_1307_mhrhcr_2.ability: Weak spot located on its rear, damage dealt to the front is significantly decreased

enemy_1303_mhshep_2.name: Hardy Hornbeast
enemy_1303_mhshep_2.desc: A variety of hornbeast which startles into a frenzy at the drop of a hat. They attack viciously, throwing their sharp horns against anything nearby without the slightest warning. Given how often they concuss themselves, scholars are extremely confused as to how they haven't gone extinct yet.
enemy_1303_mhshep_2.ability: Starts battle Resting. After being attacked, it and all surrounding hornbeasts become Combat-Ready

enemy_1076_bsthmr.name: Demolitionist
enemy_1076_bsthmr.desc: A high-level elite Reunion combatant who wears heavy-duty, explosion-proof protective gear. Their special Originium-powered hammers have massive destructive range, and must be dealt with cautiously.
enemy_1076_bsthmr.ability: Attacks cause an explosion, dealing Splash damage to units around the primary target.

enemy_1113_empace.name: Imperial Striker
enemy_1113_empace.desc: The powerful infantry of the Ursus Army, the backbone of the Imperial Army's aggressive advance. They are versatile in offense and defense, melee and ranged. After sustain a certain amount of damage, their morale will peak, causing them to inflict more destruction.
enemy_1113_empace.ability: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%

enemy_1111_ucommd.name: Ursus Raider
enemy_1111_ucommd.desc: Special forces within the Ursus Army that strike a balance between mobility and breakthrough capabilities. Good at fighting underequipped enemy forces.
enemy_1111_ucommd.ability:
Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
Can use long-ranged weapons to attack <Ursus Civilians> and <Talulah, the Fighter>

enemy_1353_esabr.name: Paramilitary Gangster
enemy_1353_esabr.desc: A gangster hired to sow chaos, often picking fights. Their employer has provided them with an experimental thermal amplification device.
enemy_1353_esabr.ability:
Energy Capacity: 10; Gains [Overload] upon reaching max Energy.
[Overload] Greatly increases ASPD, DEF, and RES for a period of time.

enemy_1357_erob.name: Paramilitary Axeman
enemy_1357_erob.desc: An outlaw hired to sow chaos, equipped with a thermal energy axe that consumes too much power. The energy supply isn't quite sufficient to start it up.
enemy_1357_erob.ability:
Energy Capacity: 20; Gains [Overload] upon reaching max Energy.
Continuously drains 1 Energy from all nearby ground enemies.
[Overload] Greatly increases ASPD, DEF, and RES for a longer period of time.

enemy_1357_erob_2.name: Paramilitary Axeman Leader

enemy_1222_dpvt_2.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Warrior Captain

enemy_1220_dzoms_2.name: Touch of Benevolence
enemy_1220_dzoms_2.desc: One of the Sanguinarch of Vampires' more elaborate creations, flexible and difficult to defeat. Reborn Creation (takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage)

enemy_1224_dsuply_2.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Retrofit ASV

One who was powerful in life will continue to be a great threat to their enemies even after being reshaped by the power of the Sanguinarch's blessing. Reborn Creation (takes greatly reduced Physical and Arts damage)

enemy_1226_dklord_2.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Wrathgorger
enemy_1226_dklord_2.desc: An elite soldier of the Sarkaz Royal Court blessed by the Sanguinarch of Vampires. The wrath of their compatriots slain on the battlefield builds up within them, making them more than eager to tear apart every last enemy of the Sarkaz.

enemy_1268_nhnrs_2.name: Sarkaz Wither Caster Captain
enemy_1268_nhnrs_2.desc: Elite member of the Nachzehrer army. Experts at healing their kin as they attack the enemy. Life is a constant cycle of devouring and sharing.

enemy_1266_nhapos.name: Rot Eater

enemy_1049_eagent.name: Agent

enemy_1404_msnip_2.name: Heavy Crossbowman Hunter

A crisp beep, then fresh toast spread with jam falls directly onto your plate.

Widely used in Propeller Paradise to keep things afloat, this upgraded version is an excellent performer that offers both power and stability, as well as the ability to repel fowlbeasts.

Shake the bottle vigorously for three hundred seconds then pry the cap open according to the instructions, and it will shoot into the sky with immense force. Don't worry, the bottle is made of high-toughness acrylic that will not break easily.

Flying unit.

enemy_1104_lfkght_2.name: Blade Helmet Knightclub Elite

enemy_10045_parrot_2.name: Unlucky Flyfin

enemy_10049_pcaptn_2.desc: The boatswain's saltfin has caught the sailors' attention, but it does not stop bellowing when the boatswain wants it to. Forced to yell above the saltfin's cacophony, the boatswain has developed a bel canto voice so beautiful that it may impress the salt flat itself.

enemy_1395_dhxts.name: Fieldmus

enemy_1309_mhboar.name: Direswine
enemy_1309_mhboar.desc: A robustly built omnivore, with an impenetrable epidermis leaving them with few natural predators. Violent headbutts are both their method of attack and a habit necessary for suppressing the growth of their fangs.

enemy_10210_muwiz.name: Ursus War Caster
enemy_10210_muwiz.desc: War Casters, an outstanding special troop type of the Empire. Through drugs and training, the Ursus force non-infected survivors of the 'Tempering' to wield powerful casting units—and as with everything else, they never care how many die because of it.

enemy_1131_sbeast.name: Mutant Sand Beast
enemy_1131_sbeast.desc: A sand beast infected by an Originiutant. Sand beasts are a species of small-sized omnivores that primarily inhabit deserts and hamadas. They are nocturnal in nature and are often tamed by the local Sargonians to be used as hunting beasts.

enemy_1132_sarchn.name: Mutant Rock Spider
enemy_1132_sarchn.desc: A rock spider infected by an Originiutant. Due to their similar appearances, rock spiders are often mistakenly believed to be a close relative of Infused Originium Slugs. However, the latest research shows that they are two completely different species.

enemy_1133_harchn.name: Mutant Giant Rock Spider
enemy_1133_harchn.desc: A giant rock spider infected by an Originiutant. Giant rock spiders are a subspecies of rock spider found only in Sargon. They possess a large circular abdomen used to store energy.

enemy_1133_harchn_2.name: Mutant Giant Rock Spider α

enemy_1137_plasm.name: Originiutant Excrescence

enemy_1143_merrpg.name: Anti-Armor Infantry
enemy_1143_merrpg.desc: A mercenary specializing in anti-armor combat. Carries a single-use grenade launcher which is discarded after firing along with other non-essential equipment, after which they charge at high speed towards the enemy.

enemy_1144_merlgd.name: War Phantom

enemy_1062_rager_2.desc: An enemy combatant who has completely given in to primal madness as their lifeforce is consumed. The infection has penetrated their bone marrow, and their death-defying aggression breaks the bounds of reason. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.

enemy_1514_smephi.name: Mephisto, 'The Singer'
enemy_1514_smephi.desc: You seem to recognize the mysterious, mythical beast that has descended from the Sarcophagus. An otherworldly song flows from its sharp beak and floods its surroundings. enemy_2138_shdbjg.name: Hanko
enemy_2138_shdbjg.desc: His violence and his rule were beyond question—he was Bolívar. He allowed every dissenter to stand before him, and then informed them of this fact. enemy_1193_krgbsk.desc: A berserker of the icefields. The blistering cold brings them joy, and glacial winds do naught but excite them. An environment that their enemies would consider harsh is nothing out of the ordinary to them.

enemy_10144_xdelk_2.name: Blackhorn Rhuul

enemy_2145_cadejo.name: Cadejo, Source of the Blackflow
enemy_2145_cadejo.desc: Lord of Hounds, whose body is the Blackflow Forest itself. Its blood nourished the land of Bolívar and the generations of life that thrived there.
