'Power output? Look, our priorities are providing our operators with a safe working environment and sufficient moral support, not making this thing do complex work.'

enemy_1273_stmgun.name: Londinium Mobile Defense Artillery
enemy_1273_stmgun.desc: Part of Londinium's city defenses. Has a large attack area. Built by the city's workers in their factories.
enemy_1273_stmgun.ability:
Capable of long-range attacks
Locks on to the target with the highest max HP and bombards it several times, dealing Arts damage to the unit in range with the highest HP percentage

enemy_1292_duskld_2.name: Dublinn Flamechaser Elite Guard
enemy_1292_duskld_2.desc: An elite Dublinn defender fused with their Leader's ember. Chasing their Leader's ember even more fervently, the Arts embedded in their equipment make them hard to defeat.
enemy_1292_duskld_2.ability:
Attacks deal additional <$ba.dt.burning>Burn</> and takes reduced Physical and Arts damage while near burning Reeds
When defeated, turns into an <$ba.invisible>Invisible</> <Ember of Avarice> that must be damaged 10 times to defeat; respawns after a period of time

enemy_1176_dusocr_2.name: Dublinn Evocator Leader
enemy_1176_dusocr_2.desc: An evocation caster leader in the Dublinn forces who can control fireballs, they are more adept at using Originium Arts than their underlings. Their leader's teachings reverberate in their minds as they work to purify the corruption of Terra in raging flames.
enemy_1176_dusocr_2.ability: Controls <Purifying Flames> that move along the ground and explode after hitting a melee ally unit, dealing Arts damage and <$ba.dt.burning>Burn</>; damage dealt decreases with distance moved

enemy_2147_shophm.name: Lorenz, Error of Perturbation
enemy_2147_shophm.desc: Chief scientist of Columbia's 'Source-Tier Cube' project and daughter of the former project lead, Robert—Toni Lorenz. Hatred, regret, and love turned into scattered data, then gathered again like quicksand; she has already seen too much in the time that has passed. Now the road to the only possible outcome unfolds before her, and she will press the button that ends everything with her own hand.
enemy_2147_shophm.ability:
Attempts to move toward the <Source-Tier Cube>; upon reaching the goal, destroys the <Source-Tier Cube>, deducts 30 Life Points, and causes all units on the field to take continuous True damage
【Quadrant Lockdown】Seals off nearby ground, permanently preventing allied units from being deployed there
When defeated, removes the <Source-Tier Cube>'s invincibility and makes it start acting

enemy_2148_shorbb.name: Source-Tier Cube
enemy_2148_shorbb.desc: The final result of two generations of Lorenz research. Once activated, it converts the energy contained in Originium into a third phase state, causing immeasurable information contamination and tampering. No one knows the consequences of fully activating Originium energy on this scale, and no one wants to find out.
enemy_2148_shorbb.ability:
Initially invincible; after <Lorenz, Error of Perturbation> is killed, loses invincibility, starts acting, and summons several <Source-Tier Cube Modules>
Takes reduced Physical and Arts damage, further reduced if the damage comes from the left or right side
【Unlinked Fission】Deals Arts damage to all allied units on the field; cooldown is reduced when own HP is below half
Summons Source-Tier Particles; summons more Source-Tier Particles when own HP is below half
After all <Source-Tier Cube Modules> disappear, becomes invincible again and <Lorenz, Error of Perturbation> returns to the battlefield

enemy_1330_cbrush_2.name: 'Offender' Prototype
enemy_1330_cbrush_2.desc: Unmanned attack vehicles primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski. Equipped with advanced power units, they fiercely assault the enemy with their solid defenses and high speed.
enemy_1330_cbrush_2.ability:
Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
When passing by an Operator, deals physical damage to them based on Movement Speed

enemy_1256_lyacpa_2.name: R-11a Assault Power Armor
enemy_1256_lyacpa_2.desc: A model equipped with long-ranged weapons, massively increasing its offensive capabilities. It's difficult to imagine what sort of changes might come about if this tech could be mass-produced.

enemy_1255_lybgpa_2.name: R-31a Heavy Power Armor
enemy_1255_lybgpa_2.desc: A model that appeared around half a year ago among some mercenary groups, its performance is on par with mass-produced military models from five years ago. Technology is unregulated, so Columbians continue to seek greater efficiency within the bounds of the law.
enemy_1255_lybgpa_2.ability: [Overload] Continuously deals Physical damage to the target proportional to the unit's ATK, and<$ba.stun>Stuns</> the target

enemy_1331_cbsisy_2.name: 'Crossroads' Prototype
enemy_1331_cbsisy_2.desc: Unmanned defense vehicles primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski. They emit intense mid-length lasers in all four directions, providing first-class defense in narrow corridors, and dramatically hindering the enemy even in open terrain.
enemy_1331_cbsisy_2.ability:
Attacks in 4 directions while moving, dealing Arts damage and deals increased damage to nearby targets
Continuously tries to push nearby <Planetary Debris>

enemy_2149_shorsm.name: Source-Tier Particle
enemy_2149_shorsm.desc: Fragments of the third phase state released when the Source-Tier Cube is opened, causing indiscriminate information contamination and tampering to everything around them. Shredding, twisting, reconstructing—everything will change.
enemy_2149_shorsm.ability: Explodes upon death, dealing True damage

enemy_1254_lypa_2.name: Test Power Armor
enemy_1254_lypa_2.desc: An unpiloted Power Armor. It seems to have a mind of its own, and even experienced engineers struggle to tell if it's being piloted.

enemy_2150_shchmr.name: Bolívar, Core of the Crux
enemy_2150_shchmr.desc: In the end, we live our whole lives alongside the ugliest parts of ourselves, forever trying to overcome them—or being devoured by them.
enemy_2150_shchmr.ability:
Form 1
Attacks reduce the target's DEF
【Maw of Calamity】Activates when HP drops to 0: temporarily leaves the field, immediately destroys any 'Decrepit Hulk' or 'Disintegration' on the field, and seals units in the deployment zone for a long time;
Targets the Operator with the highest HP on the field, continuously dealing heavy True damage around them, and deals lesser Arts damage to all other targets on the field;
If the chosen target leaves the field, the duration of 【Maw of Calamity】 is extended; after the skill ends, enters the next form
Form 2
【Unquenched Land】Launches a fireball at a target, dealing Arts damage and leaving fire around the target that deals continuous Arts damage; prioritizes targets not standing in fire
When HP drops to 0, activates 【Maw of Calamity】 again; after the skill ends, returns to the field and switches to the next form
Form 3
Periodically takes off for a while; while airborne, does not perform normal attacks but frequently uses 【Unquenched Land】
After a long time, activates 【Maw of Calamity】 again

enemy_1350_mgcshp_2.name: Fashion Street 'Supernova Caster'
enemy_1350_mgcshp_2.desc: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from a mysterious divination shop that will make people who notice it 'see stars'! It has become even stronger due to the latest limited-edition magic hat on its head.
enemy_1350_mgcshp_2.ability: Attacks 3 units simultaneously when in contact with Carmine Steam

enemy_10084_hlegle_2.name: 'Witness of the Sankta'
enemy_10084_hlegle_2.desc: Mutated haloed fowlbeast that the Law has determined to be Sankta. They have learned to pray and circle above the streets and alleys of the Holy City. They are the Holy City's perception of itself.
enemy_10084_hlegle_2.ability:
Flying unit.
Gains <$ba.fear>Fear</> for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time
Attempts to steal 1 Ammo from the target when attacking, and deals heavy Physical damage if attempt is unsuccessful

enemy_10086_hltigr_2.name: 'Crawl of the Sankta'
enemy_10086_hltigr_2.desc: Haloed terrestrial creature that the Law has determined to be Sankta. Empathy has taught these mute creatures the existence of faith. They have learned to pray and they want to know more. They can often be spotted chasing after confessionals in the city.
enemy_10086_hltigr_2.ability: Gains <$ba.fear>Fear</> for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time

enemy_1047_sagent.name: Sniper
enemy_1047_sagent.desc: A basic ranged soldier. They have very long range. Their sniper rifles can launch special ammunition capable of stunning our Operators.
enemy_1047_sagent.ability: After two attacks, the next attack <$ba.stun>Stuns</> its target

enemy_10001_trslim.name: Basic Slug
enemy_10001_trslim.desc: An Originium slug raised in captivity. Has a relatively low infection rate and a rather ordinary taste. Its anatomical structure is different from that of wild slugs.
enemy_10001_trslim.ability: Flees when HP is under 50%! Gains bonus Movement Speed and cannot be blocked for a period of time.

enemy_10164_tjgxb.name: Wield Arms
enemy_10164_tjgxb.desc: Scriptgeist born of the influence of a Sui proxy, whose original name was 'Soldier'. The histories write: 'Upon the peaks was the beast cornered and killed.' It was the battlefield where the Feranmut was hunted, and where countless soldiers were buried. The smoke dissipates and the broken armor sinks into the sand, as the bleached bones hope to return in spring.
enemy_10164_tjgxb.ability: Vanishes when encountering another type of enemy, granting the target a portion of this unit's ATK, DEF, and RES, stacking up to 3 times per unit

enemy_1000_gopro_2.name: Hound Pro
enemy_1000_gopro_2.desc: A creature controlled by a Reunion recon squad that is more dangerous than a normal Hound. Monitoring equipment is strapped to its body. Due to their speed and evasiveness, they can easily slip through enemy defenses and cause heavy damage.

enemy_10162_mnctpt.name: Handmade Catapult
enemy_10162_mnctpt.desc: Catapult handmade from cardboard by Minoan citizens, limiting its power. It has been loaded with too many rocks, making bringing it to its destination an exhausting task and hampering its accuracy as the operator's hand is usually shaking from fatigue by the time it is actually used.
enemy_10162_mnctpt.ability:
Attacks hit 3 times and deal physical splash damage
Aim deviates randomly when Immersed

enemy_10033_cnvbsk_2.name: Streetside Fire Maestro
enemy_10033_cnvbsk_2.desc: An accomplished maestro of the fire dance, who injects Siracusan style into this foreign dance. The closer to Carnevale, the more he plays with fire, and the more accidents he causes.
enemy_10033_cnvbsk_2.ability:
<$ba.invisible>Invisible</>, normally does not attack, but counters when losing Invisibility
Attacks deal Arts damage and <$ba.dt.burning>Burn</>.
Loses Invisibility during Carnevale

enemy_10033_cnvbsk.name: Streetside Fire Juggler
enemy_10033_cnvbsk.desc: An artist who brings fire to the streets, performing a dance from faraway lands. The closer to Carnevale, the more he practices—how to precisely injure a particular target among the crowd, that is.
enemy_10033_cnvbsk.ability:
<$ba.invisible>Invisible</>, normally does not attack, but counters when losing Invisibility
Attacks deal Arts damage and <$ba.dt.burning>Burn</>.
Loses Invisibility during Carnevale

enemy_2153_shcan.name: Cannot
enemy_2153_shcan.desc: A mysterious merchant who walks the wilds. If it exists in civilization, he sells it.
enemy_2153_shcan.ability:
Cannot be blocked; greatly increases own Movement Speed for a while when attacked
When a <Kannot's Safe> is nearby, makes it disappear and reduces the Physical and Arts damage it takes (stacks up to 5 times)
When defeated, sets the purchase price of some shop slots to 0 based on the number and grade of safes retrieved
Steals 99 Originium Ingots upon entering the Protection Objective
After battle, shop items whose purchase price was not set to 0 will disappear

enemy_10196_ubba.name: Desperate Breadwinner
enemy_10196_ubba.desc:
An employee of the Warehouse 22 security firm. With every punch he throws, he silently mutters the name of his severely sick child.
'You made a mistake, soldier. You can't stay in the army, but we can give you another chance.'
enemy_10196_ubba.ability:
When the alert is triggered, increases Movement Speed and searches a large range for the unit that triggered it
Nearby enemies take reduced Physical and Arts damage

enemy_1404_msnip.name: Heavy Crossbowman Ambusher
enemy_1404_msnip.desc: A sniper issued with a mass-produced kinetically-boosted crossbow. Though expensive, they are well worth the price tag, capable of stunning targets for long durations after being charged up.
enemy_1404_msnip.ability:
<$ba.invisible>Invisible</>
Launches a Straight Shot when positioned in a straight line with an allied unit: fires 1 bolt in the target's direction that deals Arts damage and inflicts <$ba.stun>Stun</>

enemy_1151_dslntc_2.name: Nourished Reaper
enemy_1151_dslntc_2.desc: A Sea Terror that emits ear-splitting screeches and has sated its hunger. It is essentially harmless if you don't disturb it.
enemy_1151_dslntc_2.ability:
Starts battle in Standby and will not attack
After being injured, this unit becomes Combat-Ready, gradually losing HP over time and continually inflicting <$ba.dt.neural>Nervous Impairment</> to nearby units

enemy_10075_mpwrj.name: Worry-Free Cargo Helper
enemy_10075_mpwrj.desc: It will brave the chaos and deliver the goods safely to their destination, even when all hell is breaking loose on Rhodes Island. Whether the goods themselves are dangerous is none of its concern.
enemy_10075_mpwrj.ability:
Flying unit.
Self-destructs immediately when there is an Operator nearby, dealing a large amount of Arts damage to surrounding units

enemy_1152_dsurch.name: Pocket Sea Crawler
enemy_1152_dsurch.desc: A Sea Terror imbued with impurities. The density of its body tissue surpasses that of some alloys. Victims stabbed by it will feel as if they have been set alight.
enemy_1152_dsurch.ability: Whenever a certain percentage of HP is lost, immediately deal a large amount of Arts damage and <$ba.dt.neural>Nervous Impairment</> to nearby units

enemy_1153_dsexcu.name: Primal Sea Piercer
enemy_1153_dsexcu.desc: A Sea Terror that grew a solid organ. The other parts of its body seem to be forming impregnable outer spikes.
enemy_1153_dsexcu.ability: Prioritizes attacking the target with the current lowest HP percentage within a small area

enemy_1148_dssbr.name: Deep Sea Slider
enemy_1148_dssbr.desc: A Sea Terror that crawled onto the shore. It brandishes its tough appendages menacingly.

enemy_1147_dshond.name: Shell Sea Runner
enemy_1147_dshond.desc: A Sea Terror that grew four limbs, but lacks an internal skeleton. It seems to have once hunted quadrupeds on land.

enemy_1392_dhshld.name: Scum
enemy_1392_dhshld.desc: A large fabric construct that uses its huge mass and thick skin to run rampant across the paddies, detested by farmers.
enemy_1392_dhshld.ability:
More likely to be attacked
Causes heavy Blight to the paddy when defeated

enemy_1390_dhsbr.name: Filth
enemy_1390_dhsbr.desc: A fabric construct born from the farmers' fears of a poor harvest. They carry a crop-killing Blight, and pose a great risk to agricultural yields.
enemy_1390_dhsbr.ability:
Causes Blight to the paddy when defeated
Becomes <$ba.invisible>Invisible</> on Blighted tiles

enemy_1439_dslntf_2.name: Allotropic Maleficent
enemy_1439_dslntf_2.desc: Nucleic Maleficents that have survived in harsh environments, developing glands that produce neurotoxin. Extremely rare, and extremely dangerous.
enemy_1439_dslntf_2.ability:
Becomes Combat-Ready when damaged, significantly increasing Movement Speed and continuously inflicting <$ba.dt.neural>Nervous Impairment</> on nearby units.
Destroys blocking <Excrescent Carapace> at the cost of a percentage of its HP.

enemy_1436_dsdivi_2.name: Allotropic Hoarder
enemy_1436_dsdivi_2.desc: A Divicellular Hoarder that has stockpiled excessive nutrients, capable of responding to intense stimuli.
enemy_1436_dsdivi_2.ability: Splits when HP drops below 50% for the first time.

enemy_1433_dsbasi_2.name: Allotropic Predator
enemy_1433_dsbasi_2.desc: Simple but nourished, this new generation of Seaborn collects nutrients even more efficiently.

enemy_10126_rkbomb_2.name: Abnormal Originium Slug α
enemy_10126_rkbomb_2.desc: Dangerous mutated Originium slugs that are reproducing rapidly in the new underground environment. Rapid genetic iterations have increased their threat considerably.
enemy_10126_rkbomb_2.ability:
More likely to be attacked by friendly units; takes less damage, and deals Arts damage to the attacker when attacked
Loses abilities after being attacked several times by <Miner Guerrillas>

enemy_3010_mcreep.name: Miner Guerrilla
enemy_3010_mcreep.desc: Resistance unit formed by miners, many of whom are still relatively young. They are not a rampaging mob: all they want to do is protect their families who are still underground.
enemy_3010_mcreep.ability: Allied unit; recovers HP when within any Medic Operator's Attack Range

enemy_1214_mtrmgc_2.name: Pathfinder Artifex Prefect
enemy_1214_mtrmgc_2.desc: A caster employing unusual Originium Arts. Able to extract energy from special Arts Units to inflict horrific devastation.
enemy_1214_mtrmgc_2.ability: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks inflict <$ba.dt.burning>Burn</>. Ammo capacity: 1

enemy_10159_mntrjn.name: Wooden Burdenbeast of Ilion
enemy_10159_mntrjn.desc: The wooden burdenbeast of Ilion, played by Minoan citizens. In the age of city states, Athenians captured the previously impregnable city of Ilion by hiding soldiers inside a wooden burdenbeast. The story is so well-known that a group of Minoans squeezing themselves into a vehicle is immediately understood as a recreation of the legend, and onlookers are invited to join in.
enemy_10159_mntrjn.ability:
Cannot be blocked.
<@eb.key>Carries up to 5 passengers</>
Movement Speed reduced for each additional passenger

enemy_1074_dbskar.name: Sarkaz Grudgebearer
enemy_1074_dbskar.desc: A Sarkaz mercenary. Their Originium-wracked bodies have become convenient tools in their operations, allowing them to unleash Arts without relying on a staff. Though they won't attack while on Standby, they will cruelly expend their own life to complete their mission once in Combat-Ready mode.
enemy_1074_dbskar.ability: Starts battle in Standby and will not attack; upon being injured, becomes Combat-Ready and attacks two targets with long-ranged Arts damage.

enemy_2151_shwolf.name: The Unnamed Wilds
enemy_2151_shwolf.desc: Until its enemies were tamed, they did not yet share the name Bolívar.

enemy_1277_sgman_2.name: Elite Famiglia Soldier
enemy_1277_sgman_2.desc: Battle-hardened, low-level mafiosi who are strong and swift-footed, worthy of being called elite fighters. When they are buried, the famiglia might send a letter of condolence home, nothing more.
enemy_1277_sgman_2.ability: Increases Blood Debt by a miniscule amount when defeated

enemy_1280_sgmag_2.name: Elite Famiglia Caster
enemy_1280_sgmag_2.desc: A skilled Caster can often turn the tide of a battle. Though these claim to hold formidable positions, everyone knows they are nothing without the protection of their famiglia.
enemy_1280_sgmag_2.ability:
Attacks two targets simultaneously.
Can stop attacking to continually increase Blood Debt

enemy_1283_sgkill_2.name: Famiglia Shadow Silencer
enemy_1283_sgkill_2.desc: A peerless assassin loyal to his famiglia. The shadows serve his will, and he knows murder better than the back of his hand. He can be found in the background of every secret that has allowed his famiglia to rise and flourish, and those who have seen his true face are already buried six feet under.
enemy_1283_sgkill_2.ability:
Gains additional buffs while under Asset Liquidation
<$ba.invisible>Invisible</>

enemy_1285_sgwlf.name: 'None of My Business'
enemy_1285_sgwlf.desc: A drunken man wobbling around with his hat pulled low. The incendiary bombs lying around the battlefield have nothing to do with him. At least, that's what he's always insisted in his affidavits.
enemy_1285_sgwlf.ability:
After losing a certain percentage of HP, releases a permanent incendiary field
Friendly Operators inside the field take True damage every second

enemy_1344_ddlamb.name: Hot Spring 'Mischievous Rascal'
enemy_1344_ddlamb.desc: A fluffy critter that has found something nice on the street, and wants to play with whoever it bumps into. Even though you can't make out its expression from its obscured face, you can sense it in its revelry.
enemy_1344_ddlamb.ability: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

enemy_1545_shpkg.name: Dolly, Sovereign of Sheep
enemy_1545_shpkg.desc: Sovereign of Sheep, traveling through the barrenlands and enjoying lava surfing. He sees everyone as equals, and is happy to leave their 'mark' on this great land. Now, it's time to have some fun with him!
enemy_1545_shpkg.ability:
Unblockable; permanently in <$ba.float>Low-Altitude Hovering</>
[Wool Barrier] Physical and Arts damage taken is significantly reduced when the Barrier is active. When Barrier value reaches 0, Dolly will lose his Barrier and fall, losing <$ba.float>Low-Altitude Hovering</> and becoming disarmed.
Barrier value can be significantly reduced by Steam Soda Bottle explosions.
Dolly loses Barrier value when taking damage from Operators standing around a Decorative Geyser.
Airy Dolly
Prioritizes attacking ground units, and applies Carmine Steam on tiles the targets are on
[Elated Firebreathing] Locks onto a unit, and afterwards lets loose a vertical line of fire on that target's location from top to bottom, dealing Arts damage to all units on tiles in that column and generating Carmine Steam on the tiles
[Unintentional Explosion] Stops attacking to charge energy. After a period of time, ignites all Carmine Steam from right to left, dealing Arts and <$ba.dt.burning>Burn</> to all targets in range
Frantic Dolly
Cannot attack, leaves Carmine Steam on tiles it travels over
Deals Arts damage and <$ba.dt.burning>Burn</> to units he bumps into
Dolly no longer uses [Elated Firebreathing], and will only use [Unintentional Explosion] upon making landfall

enemy_1346_ynshp.name: Hot Spring 'Wandering Vagrant'
enemy_1346_ynshp.desc: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the surfskate shop, so fast that it comes and goes without a trace! It's practicing its acceleration and turning for the upcoming 'Lava Surfing Championships.'
enemy_1346_ynshp.ability:
<$ba.invisible>Invisible</>
Can stack with a Hot Spring 'Mischievous Rascal' and leaves Carmine Steam on tiles it travels over after combining

enemy_1351_yhhshp.name: 'Fluffy Buddy'
enemy_1351_yhhshp.desc: If these gentle and difficult-to-perceive fluffy critters suddenly appear in front of you, don't be frightened! In the hot springs, atop the white clouds, and in your memories... Will you still think of them years down the line?
enemy_1351_yhhshp.ability:
Hidden in map, can be revealed by Carmine Steam or Pure White Steam
When in contact with Carmine Steam, its explosion produces more Carmine Steam on surrounding tiles and dealing Arts damage to nearby allied units
When in contact with Pure White Steam, its explosion produces more Pure White Steam on surrounding tiles and healing surrounding allied units

enemy_1350_mgcshp.name: Fashion Street 'Stellar Caster'
enemy_1350_mgcshp.desc: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from a mysterious divination shop that will make anyone who notices it 'see stars'! It's very clever, and knows that the next most important thing after a wand is the magic hat on its head!
enemy_1350_mgcshp.ability: Attacks 3 units simultaneously when in contact with Carmine Steam

enemy_1347_fyshp.name: Fashion Street 'Ordinary Aviator'
enemy_1347_fyshp.desc: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the aviation shop. It can fly, but it's not very good at it. Sometimes it can float up real high, but don't mistake it for a pink cloud!
enemy_1347_fyshp.ability:
<$ba.float>Low-Altitude Hovering</>
Can stack with a Fashion Street 'Hearty Heavy' and is capable of long-range attacks after combining

enemy_1535_wlfmster.name: Zaaro, Signore dei Lupi
enemy_1535_wlfmster.desc: Il Signore dei Lupi was born in the wilderness, but he has cast his gaze upon the world of men. His hubris is boundless, yet he falls short. His tricks exhausted, he has lost everything. Now, someone must be made to bear his wrath.
enemy_1535_wlfmster.ability:
Gradually increases Blood Debt
First Form
Damage taken is reduced and cannot be <$ba.stun>Stunned</>
[Hemolytic Horror] Causes 3 friendly units to be consumed by fear, greatly reducing their ASPD, significantly accelerating their periodic HP loss, and causing them to be unable to be retreated manually; affected units will return to normal after 'Signore dei Lupi' loses a certain percentage of HP
After the first form reaches 0 HP, gains [Primal Deterrence], reducing the ASPD of nearby friendly units, and slowly gaining HP over time
Second Form
No longer has Damage Reduction, and longer casts [Hemolytic Horror]
Attacks become ranged and strike twice, and gains increased ATK
Periodically releases a [Furious Howl], causing Blood Debt to increase rapidly

enemy_1278_sgbow_2.name: Elite Famiglia Crossbowman
enemy_1278_sgbow_2.desc: Famiglia-trained crossbowmen with a wealth of experience. Their shots are more accurate, and more deadly as well. Famiglie always respect the ironclad order, so these crossbows are never upgraded into better models, and Arts remain just as essential as ever.
enemy_1278_sgbow_2.ability: While under the Asset Liquidation status, attacks are converted into Arts damage

enemy_10035_cnvdnc_2.name: Entusiasta Lead Dancer
enemy_10035_cnvdnc_2.desc: The lead dancer from a troupe invited by big companies to liven up Carnevale. Her skirt flickers like flame, warming the crowd and setting the streets ablaze—literally!
enemy_10035_cnvdnc_2.ability:
<$ba.invisible>Invisible</>
Continuously deals Arts damage and <$ba.dt.burning>Burn</> for the skill duration, Attack Range increases when Invisibility is lost
Loses Invisibility during Carnevale

enemy_10034_cnvsax_2.name: Parading Jazz Musician
enemy_10034_cnvsax_2.desc: A musician in festive garb who's part of the parade. He's gotten pretty good with his instrument, and he knows when best to get the crowd going.
enemy_10034_cnvsax_2.ability:
<$ba.invisible>Invisible</>, normally does not attack, but counters when losing Invisibility
Continuously deals Arts damage and <$ba.dt.burning>Burn</> for the skill duration
Loses Invisibility during Carnevale

enemy_1571_mirbst.name: Rampaging Abnormal Manglerbeast
enemy_1571_mirbst.desc: Has long lost its divinity. Only its survival instinct keeps it going.
enemy_1571_mirbst.ability:
First Form
Attacks hit twice and greatly increase the damage the target takes from this unit
Enraged. Attacks both friend and foe, and seeks out units that have dealt damage to it; Physical and Arts damage taken greatly reduced, ASPD and Movement Speed greatly increased
Loses rage and attempts to flee after some time, or if HP drops below a certain level
Second Form
Reappears after a short delay, remaining enraged for a while; during this time, Physical and Arts damage taken is greatly reduced, while ATK is greatly increased
Attacks all nearby allied units
[Rockfall] Deals Physical damage to the unit that has dealt the most damage to it, inflicting <$ba.stun>Stun</>

enemy_1001_bigbo_2.name: Big Adam
enemy_1001_bigbo_2.desc: One of Reunion's squad leaders. He wears a heavy blast suit and attacks with an electric chainsaw. Bears a remarkable similarity to Big Bob, but does not appear to be the same person. It is unknown whether there is any relationship between the two of them. Data suggests that he may be even more dangerous than Big Bob. Due to his devastating attacks and extreme survivability, proceed with utmost caution.

enemy_1005_yokai_3.name: Raptor
enemy_1005_yokai_3.desc: An unmanned enemy drone, its design and name seem to be inspired by a certain space game. Equipped with a minigun and a long-range Arts receiver, they are likely operated by concealed Casters. Their outstanding stealthiness and attack power pose a major threat to Operators.

enemy_1089_ltlntc_2.name: Winterwisp Blood Magister
enemy_1089_ltlntc_2.desc: A mixed-blood well-versed in Winterwisp's ancient Blood Arts, much more terrifying than modern Casters. Their ancient sacrificial rituals are capable of instantly dealing area Arts damage, as well as severing Arts ley lines to seize control of L-44 'Gramophones.'
enemy_1089_ltlntc_2.ability:
Will gradually lose HP over time
Upon death, deals a large amount of Arts damage to all surrounding units and immediately seizes control of any 'Gramophones'

enemy_1235_dsbskr_2.name: Nourished Reefbreaker
enemy_1235_dsbskr_2.desc: A Sea Terror born from the nethersea brand, used to expel entities that pose a significant threat to its kin, or to completely destroy environments unsuitable for sustaining life. All civilizations on land fall under this category.
enemy_1235_dsbskr_2.ability:
Gains <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</> when on Nethersea Brand
Gains increased ATK for each time it deals damage, decaying quickly after it stops attacking
Deals increased damage to enemies blocking this unit

enemy_1320_wdrrl_2.name: Sarkaz Absurdist Tyrant Captain
enemy_1320_wdrrl_2.desc: A product of the cooperation between the Damazti Cluster and the Military Commission, able to change their appearance with Arts. They can skillfully manipulate their flesh without damaging their brains, and are used to employing their intimidating forms to gain an advantage in battle.
enemy_1320_wdrrl_2.ability:
Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
First attack deals Splash damage

enemy_1359_ekulsr_2.name: Paramilitary Bombardier Leader
enemy_1359_ekulsr_2.desc: A mercenary hired to sow chaos, equipped with a compressed-air grenade launcher. The gas cylinder has been heated to such a degree that their colleagues are afraid to get close.
enemy_1359_ekulsr_2.ability:
Energy Capacity: 30; Gains [Overload] upon reaching max Energy.

While not blocked, launches grenades that deal damage to the target and surrounding units.

enemy_1362_dfat_2.name: Sarkaz Heirbearer Scourger
enemy_1362_dfat_2.desc: An elite formation-breaker of the Sarkaz Royal Court that has received the blessing of the Sanguinarch of Vampires. Said to have disobeyed the Sanguinarch's will, however the Sanguinarch did not punish them for their transgressions. In return, these warriors convert their regret into endless slaughter and wash away their guilt with blood.
enemy_1362_dfat_2.ability:
After several attacks, <$ba.stun>Stuns</> friendly units in an area.
Will be reborn as a <Gift of Magnanimity> after falling in battle for the first time

enemy_10019_sgmum_2.name: 'Bejeweled Slab Guardian'
enemy_10019_sgmum_2.desc: Strange entities sighted amongst the jewel constructs. The bejeweled stone slabs that they carry shine brightly in the night streets, like glowing great swords.

Starts with low DEF and RES, but permanently gains DEF when taking Physical damage and RES when taking Arts damage, up to a maximum.

enemy_10118_ymgprc.name: Mio
enemy_10118_ymgprc.desc: Drive out oni, and you drive out dreams. Welcome in curses, and you welcome in kindness. Ask not of right or wrong, or good and evil. She simply draws her sword in silence.
enemy_10118_ymgprc.ability:
Attacks hit 2 times

Bounces <'Certain Fates'>

enemy_10108_mjclun_2.name: Sleepwalking Butler
enemy_10108_mjclun_2.desc: Butler puppet that wanders the Castle of Dreams in the long night. The moonlight transforms its scissors, allowing it to cut even larger cloth... The scissors are for cutting cloth, right?

enemy_10123_uareap_2.name: Fortbreaker Mk-II
enemy_10123_uareap_2.desc: Next-generation war machine developed by the First Arsenal of Ursus, with increased power output and ammo capacity. The trade-off is that the pilot's escape pod was removed.

enemy_1152_dsurch_2.name: Nourished Crawler
enemy_1152_dsurch_2.desc: A Sea Terror imbued with impurities that has had its hunger sated. Such Sea Terrors are rarely seen nowadays, as they are gradually evolving to become more nimble.

enemy_1063_rageth.name: Enraged Possessed Thrower
enemy_1063_rageth.desc: An enemy ranged combatant who has slowly descended into primal madness as their lifeforce is consumed. The infection has penetrated their bone marrow, and they will hurl whatever they can get their hands on at their targets. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.
enemy_1063_rageth.ability: Will gradually lose HP over time

enemy_1194_krgmtr.name: Tschäggättä
enemy_1194_krgmtr.desc: A special ops squad secretly formed in Victoria by SilverAsh, based on the Kjerag folk legend 'Tschäggättä' used to hush crying children. They are able to resist brutally cold temperatures, and are extremely proficient in mountainous combat.

Attacks lower the target's DEF

enemy_1356_egun_2.name: Paramilitary Sniper Leader
enemy_1356_egun_2.desc: An outlaw hired to sow chaos, well-accustomed to using thermal energy blasters and eager to just start blasting.
enemy_1356_egun_2.ability:
Energy Capacity: 20; Gains [Overload] upon reaching max Energy.
Periodically stops moving and continuously provides Energy to all enemies within attack range.
[Overload] Greatly increases ASPD, DEF, and RES for a longer period of time.

enemy_1412_mmjump_2.name: Scrap Inventor
enemy_1412_mmjump_2.desc: Inventors who have built a lot of new equipment, but have yet to finish design work on devices for flying and landing.
enemy_1412_mmjump_2.ability: Temporarily takes flight when blocked or facing a Stabilizer Chain for the first time. DEF is greatly reduced after landing.

enemy_10116_ymgtop_2.name: Suiton Master
enemy_10116_ymgtop_2.desc: A ninja that attacks by spinning in place. Claims that creating a vortex from air is a type of suiton too, even without water around him. Nobody wants to go out with him because he refuses to walk properly.
enemy_10116_ymgtop_2.ability:

Bounces <'Certain Fates'>

enemy_10054_cjhot.name: Boiling Pot
enemy_10054_cjhot.desc: Abomination born of the influence of a Sui Proxy. Boil chili and pepper in the pot, and let the aroma drift across town. Do not be too hasty when you tuck in, lest the heat burn your mouth.
enemy_10054_cjhot.ability:
Continuously inflicts Arts damage and <$ba.dt.burning>Burn</> to its surroundings
Immune to <$ba.sluggish>Slow</>

enemy_2010_csdcr.name: Scarlet Singer
enemy_2010_csdcr.desc: A performer of the Crimson Troupe, they unleash their singing voices when sufficiently stimulated, inciting their followers to attack in a frenzy.

Attacks inflict additional <$ba.dt.neural>Nervous Impairment</>
After receiving a certain number of hits, greatly increases all enemies' ASPD for a short period

enemy_2023_sypult.name: Retching Broodmother
enemy_2023_sypult.desc: Sea Terror mothers that throw fake offspring at oncoming threats, allowing the true offspring to flee.

Can only attack ground targets

enemy_2024_synut.name: Baleful Broodling
enemy_2024_synut.desc: An extension of the broodmother's body, identical to newly-born offspring.

enemy_10114_ymgsld.name: Pessimistic Oath-Brother
enemy_10114_ymgsld.desc: A shield-wielding elite Kinsekikai bruiser who believes that life is a constant cycle of losing one's balance and starting over.

DEF is reduced when Barrier is lost

enemy_2030_symon2.name: Tidelinked Immortal
enemy_2030_symon2.desc: —Sea Terror. The product of both technology and evolutionary instincts.
enemy_2030_symon2.ability:

Has lower HP and ATK, but higher ASPD and Movement Speed

enemy_10104_mjcbln_2.name: Background Master
enemy_10104_mjcbln_2.desc: Strange puppets that build the set for the neverwaking story. They are trying to adjust the light with balloons. Someone tell them about curtains, please?

Continuously inflates a balloon in place of attacking; when balloon is full, gains <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> and <$ba.float>Low-Altitude Hovering</>

enemy_1206_msfpin_2.name: Porcelain Vase
enemy_1206_msfpin_2.desc: The original form of 'Scarletmist.' Bright in color, its shape is elegant and solid.

Cannot be blocked.
Must be damaged 15 times by Arts or True damage to defeat

enemy_2009_csaudc.name: Derisive Audience
enemy_2009_csaudc.desc: A diehard fan of the Crimson Troupe, they enjoy the performances night and day. They have become as incomprehensible as the troupe itself.

enemy_10164_tjgxb_2.name: Wield Arms - Oppress
enemy_10164_tjgxb_2.desc: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Soldier'. The histories write: 'Upon the peaks was the beast cornered and killed.' It was the battlefield where the Feranmut was hunted, and where countless soldiers were buried. Swords and spears lie buried, and tears of blood have stopped flowing. The bleached bones shall know spring no more.
enemy_10164_tjgxb_2.ability: Vanishes when encountering another type of enemy, granting the target a portion of this unit's ATK, DEF, and RES, stacking up to 3 times per unit

enemy_10165_tjggb_2.name: Draw Bow - Screech
enemy_10165_tjggb_2.desc: Scriptgeist driven mad from the influence of Sui, whose original name was 'Bow'. The histories write: 'Where does the bowstring return, across thousands of miles to the Pass?' Every goodbye on that bridge was solemn and earnest. The sandstorm rages, and the bowstring wails, yet its bearer is nowhere to be seen, but for the lingering echoes of the string's ring.
enemy_10165_tjggb_2.ability:
Hits 3 times
Prioritizes attacking allies on Glyph Tiles

enemy_2012_csbln.name: 'Small Surprise'
enemy_2012_csbln.desc: A special gift prepared by the Crimson Troupe for the audience. Every audience member who receives a gift will become particularly 'ecstatic'.

Flying unit.
Upon death, deals Arts damage to all surrounding units and inflicts <$ba.dt.neural>Nervous Impairment</>

enemy_2017_csphts.name: Ominous Apparition
enemy_2017_csphts.desc: A patch of shadow. It has never once left, nor has it ever truly existed.

enemy_2101_dyspll.name: Talisman
enemy_2101_dyspll.desc: Paper talisman seen throughout the Garden of Grotesqueries, with various messages written on them: Timetables, notes, tips, prohibitions... Endowed with meaning by the hand of man, it stubbornly refuses to leave anyone that it sticks to.

Destroyed after taking a certain number of attacks
When attached to a target, deals Arts damage every second and prevents them from using skills

enemy_2104_dycast.name: Mirror Tianshi
enemy_2104_dycast.desc: A well-polished mirror that believes it sees everything clearly. When it became a Geist, it was not content with just seeing things, but could not stop itself from giving unsolicited advice, just like the old scholars in the Tianshi Bureau.
enemy_2104_dycast.ability: Picks a target from very long range, dealing Arts damage and sending a <Talisman>

enemy_2025_syufo.name: Skimming Sea Drifter
enemy_2025_syufo.desc: Some Sea Terrors have begun to adapt to the sky, able to glide above the waves for extended periods. Perhaps this branch will eventually evolve to make their home in the heavens.

enemy_10150_nsheat.name: Scorching Propeller
enemy_10150_nsheat.desc:
Widely used in Propeller Paradise to keep things afloat, it is an excellent performer that offers both power and stability.
Unfortunately, its poor cooling causes platforms equipped with it to feel like midsummer all year round.
enemy_10150_nsheat.ability:
Flying unit.
Continuously inflicts <$ba.dt.burning>Burn</> on all other nearby units
Grants 1 Buoyancy when on a Levitatable Zone

enemy_10151_nspace.name: Skystrider Porta-Potty
enemy_10151_nspace.desc:
What is the most important feature for a facility that can avoid the traffic and reach the client in time, regardless of road conditions?
The Volvort Kochinski Flying Restroom, which ceased production after just two weeks, was definitely not the answer. Perhaps the price of 500 certs per call was too much?
enemy_10151_nspace.ability:
Flying unit.
When defeated for the first time, crashes and becomes debris with extremely high DEF, nullifying 1 Buoyancy if on a Levitatable Zone

enemy_1385_winbom_2.name: 'Boom Canister'
enemy_1385_winbom_2.desc: After many broken and exploded cans, people came to the realization that this weapon needed someone with a death wish, making trench warfare even more painful.
enemy_1385_winbom_2.ability: On death, deals Arts damage to all nearby units, inflicting Cold and disabling Emergency Heaters.

enemy_1388_wingnt_2.name: 'Mortar'
enemy_1388_wingnt_2.desc: Elite grenadiers of the delegation, able to throw shells with the same power as city artillery. No one in the delegation is foolish enough to challenge them, so they roam the snow with their carefully crafted balls, waiting for a challenger foolish enough to fall into their trap.

enemy_1402_tgshd_2.name: Heavy Scout
enemy_1402_tgshd_2.desc: A heavily-armored scout. The Coalition Army has reinforced the armor, but has no clue how to upgrade the tracing function.

Exposes the attacker for 5s when attacked
When Exposed, allied units cannot use barricades to keep themselves out of enemy's sight, and take more damage

enemy_1306_mhtrtl_2.name: Keratex Clawbeast
enemy_1306_mhtrtl_2.desc: A Chitotex Clawbeast subspecies particular to certain regions. Their sturdy upper limbs accelerate their excavation of rock exponentially, while their stern shells can shrug off severe batterings. These traits allow them to better expand their territory.

enemy_1134_diamd_2.name: Originiutant α
enemy_1134_diamd_2.desc: An Originiutant mutant that was weaponized for some purpose. Even more ferocious and terrifying than usual.

enemy_1507_mephi.name: Mephisto
enemy_1507_mephi.desc: A Medic who is one of Reunion's squad leaders, often working in tandem with Faust. He heals the wounded while commanding his troops to attack, and can improve their life recovery rate. He boasts a high resistance to Arts. Currently, it has been confirmed that he is the one controlling the Hosts.
enemy_1507_mephi.ability:
Doubles the HP regeneration of all enemies on the field
Regular attacks heal 3 enemies simultaneously

enemy_10098_crhro_2.name: Destined Hero
enemy_10098_crhro_2.desc: The hero. His motto is 'Never say die', and he will see it done. His special effects sword decapitates his enemies, and he watches their blood spill on the floor with satisfaction while screams fill the set. He will fight to the bitter end.
enemy_10098_crhro_2.ability:
Attacks inflict <$ba.dt.neural>Nervous Impairment</>.
Attack range increases when inside the Filming Area, and prioritizes <Villain's Minion> and <Destined Villain>
Rebirth

enemy_10099_crvln_2.name: Destined Villain
enemy_10099_crvln_2.desc: The villain. Its motto is 'Never surrender'. This position is reserved for the strong. It spits out special effects shockwaves and watches with glee as the hero's body is torn to pieces and all traces of his existence erased. It will fight to the bitter end.
enemy_10099_crvln_2.ability:
Attacks inflict <$ba.dt.neural>Nervous Impairment</>.
Attacks hit twice when inside the Filming Area, and prioritizes <Hero's Sidekick> and <Destined Hero>

enemy_2031_syboy.name: Pathshaper
enemy_2031_syboy.desc: Seaborn tasked with exploring evolutionary pathways, its fractals mapping out dead ends so that we many can stay on the right path.

Every 3rd attack summons a <Pathshaper Fractal>
Summons 1 <Pathshaper Fractal> after taking a number of attacks

enemy_2032_syboy2.name: Lingering Pathshaper
enemy_2032_syboy2.desc: Seaborn tasked with exploring evolutionary pathways. Its injuries and those suffered by its fractals become a guide for the evolution of we many.
enemy_2032_syboy2.ability:
Every 3rd attack summons a <Pathshaper Fractal>
Summons 1 <Pathshaper Fractal> after taking a few attacks

enemy_2033_syboys.name: Pathshaper Fractal
enemy_2033_syboys.desc: Fractals left behind by the Seaborn Pathshaper. Illusions must eventually vanish. The path is not clear. Search on, search on.

Dies after some time
Every 3rd attack summons a <Pathshaper Fractal>

enemy_10125_uacomd_2.name: Army Senior Commander
enemy_10125_uacomd_2.desc: Senior commanders of the Ursus Army. Their loyalty to Ursus is beyond doubt, signified by the emblems of nobility on their uniform.
enemy_10125_uacomd_2.ability:
Gives <@eb.key>orders</> to Army enemies on the field
Can fight 1 <Miner Guerrilla> at a time

enemy_10162_mnctpt_2.name: Refurbished Lithobolos
enemy_10162_mnctpt_2.desc: Stone thrower from the city-state era, repurposed for use in theater. Classical architecture and modern buildings blend together on the streets of Minos, as do relics from the classical period, gaining new life in the hands of modern Minoans. It remains heavy, however, and the operator's hand still shakes.
enemy_10162_mnctpt_2.ability:
Attacks hit 3 times and deal physical splash damage
Aim deviates randomly when Immersed

enemy_10163_mnctur_2.name: Brave Palladulis
enemy_10163_mnctur_2.desc: The hero Palladulis, played by two Minoans. They have become experts at playing Palladulis, working in perfect tandem to recreate his heroic charge. The one in front has gotten used to getting dazed from hitting walls, as the one in back cannot see what is in front of them.
enemy_10163_mnctur_2.ability:
Charges if there is an ally in the direction of its movement, dealing heavy Physical damage when it hits your unit

enemy_2015_csicem.name: 'Frost Buck'
enemy_2015_csicem.desc: An actor playing the role of the Sami Snowpriest's bodyguard, 'Frost Buck'. After countless performances, they have fallen completely into their role, and wish for their demise at the hands of a foe as scary as the 'Demons'.

enemy_2014_csicer.name: 'Snow Doe'
enemy_2014_csicer.desc: An actor playing the role of the Sami Snowpriest's bodyguard, 'Snow Doe'. After countless performances, they have fallen completely into their role, and wish for their demise at the hands of a foe as twisted as the 'Frozen Monstrosity'.
enemy_2014_csicer.ability:
Attacks inflict <$ba.cold>Cold</>
When <'Frost Buck'> dies, greatly increases ASPD and Movement Speed, and inherits its ability

enemy_1427_lrnazg_2.desc: The Putrefied Sudaram is the shroud of the fallen. Once bloated from gluttony, it now nourishes its insatiable kin. For the Nachzehrer, consumption and nourishment—greed and devotion—are just two sides of the same dreaded coin.

enemy_1430_lrrook_2.name: Chalice of Mortality
enemy_1430_lrrook_2.desc: Greater soul chalice born of a revenant's will, brimming with conviction immeasurable. The future, unforeseen but destined, is the ultimate verdict.

enemy_1511_mdrock.name: Mudrock
enemy_1511_mdrock.desc: Age unknown, gender unknown, history unknown. This ex-Reunion member now leads an organization of Infected and wanders the wilderness between the cities of Leithanien. What thoughts run through Mudrock's mind as being forced to once again step upon the battlefield?

enemy_1415_mmkabi.name: Armored Burdenbeast
enemy_1415_mmkabi.desc: Large, slow, and docile, these burdenbeasts obediently undergo rigorous training to perform tasks that go against their nature.

enemy_2051_smsha2.name: Hollow Snowpriest
enemy_2051_smsha2.desc: A Sami chief long alienated from their tribe, their fervent expectations for their clan have become a signpost to nothingness. If no one stops them, they will spread the demons' influence all over Sami.
enemy_2051_smsha2.ability:

enemy_1322_wdgyht.name: 'Trilby Asher'
enemy_1322_wdgyht.desc: 'Forever honor one's commitments,' the proud motto of House Caster. While the Duke's military and political might are more than enough to back their word, the 'Trilby Ashers' are the real reason why the Duke of Caster's words hold any weight.

enemy_1419_mmcike.name: Deathveil Assassin
enemy_1419_mmcike.desc: Sarkaz assassins who have abandoned their names and cut off their horns. Behind their pall is a burning fanaticism and a destined fate.

<$ba.invisible>Invisible</>; the next attack made after breaking <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</> will deal increased damage.

enemy_2004_balloon.name: Jetman
enemy_2004_balloon.desc: One of the dessert-time jokes among Columbians involves a strange man who calls himself a 'Master Thief,' puttering around with a self-made jetpack. The most valuable thing he's stolen is a single burdenbeast. However, the fact that he made his own jetpack might mean that he really is a master.

enemy_1277_sgman.name: Famiglia Soldier
enemy_1277_sgman.desc: Low-level mafiosi who obey the orders of their superiors unquestioningly. Their lives are hardly worth anything, but their deaths are sufficient cause for their famiglia to seek revenge.

enemy_1281_sgcar.name: Famiglia Limo
enemy_1281_sgcar.desc: The famiglie's most common mode of transportation, sporting an interior as unassuming as the exterior, with only the bumper reinforced. In addition to transportation, they will also use this vehicle to bid 'buon viaggio' to their famiglia's enemies.
enemy_1281_sgcar.ability: Unloads 3 <Famiglia Soldiers> if this is unit is defeated while blocked

enemy_1283_sgkill.name: Famiglia Silencer
enemy_1283_sgkill.desc: A powerful assassin loyal to his famiglia, striking from the shadows before vanishing again, leaving only death in his wake. His title is known by all, but none dare speak of him.

Gains additional buffs while under Asset Liquidation
<$ba.invisible>Invisible</>

enemy_1345_tplamb.name: Fashion Street 'Hearty Heavy'
enemy_1345_tplamb.desc: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the sports field. It'll be really happy if you throw its 'treasure' back at it. Thankfully, it only throws frisbees, and not discuses.

enemy_1348_rllamb.name: Urban 'Whirlwind Walker'
enemy_1348_rllamb.desc: A mass of fluffy critters fighting over cotton candy, and it's a little hard to tell where the fur ends and where the candyfloss begins. The main reason the Candy House grandpa is so angry is because they snatched his wig off too!
enemy_1348_rllamb.ability:
Explodes on first attack, dealing AoE Arts damage and spawning Carmine Steam
Summons a Hot Spring 'Mischievous Rascal' and Fashion Street 'Hearty Heavy' upon dying

enemy_1082_soticn.name: Guerrilla Mortar
enemy_1082_soticn.desc: One of Patriot's elite suppression troops. Adept at long-ranged shelling, these fighters move more slowly because of their medium armor but also enjoy increased protection. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain greatly increased combat capabilities and have significantly increased attack speed.
enemy_1082_soticn.ability: When Inspired, gains greatly increased ASPD.

enemy_1078_sotisc.name: Guerrilla Fighter
enemy_1078_sotisc.desc: A basic guerilla fighter. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain increased capabilities and utilize a full range of offensive maneuvers.

enemy_1078_sotisc_2.name: Guerrilla Fighter Leader
enemy_1078_sotisc_2.desc: A veteran guerilla fighter. After receiving tactical commands, they will gain increased capabilities and utilize a full range of offensive maneuvers.

enemy_10127_rkmbst.name: Abnormal Manglerbeast
enemy_10127_rkmbst.desc: Mutated beast that dwells within the mines. It knew to avoid the strange rocks, but could not avoid drinking the black water. It lay on the gravel for several days, before standing up again.
enemy_10127_rkmbst.ability:
More likely to be attacked by friendly units; takes less damage, and gains ASPD
Loses abilities after being attacked several times by <Miner Guerrillas>

enemy_1303_mhshep.name: Hornbeast
enemy_1303_mhshep.desc: An herbivore that moves in herds, common to the mountains. Docile creatures, they hide from predators using the mock-vegetation wool on their backs, but that's no reason to underestimate their pointed horns.

enemy_1056_ganwar.name: Brawler
enemy_1056_ganwar.desc: Combat personnel who have underwent special training. Their flurry of rapid blows are powerful enough to be fatal.

enemy_1284_sgprst.name: Father Agenir
enemy_1284_sgprst.desc: Agenir, Sankta priest, one of the founders of Siracusa's ironclad order. Do not hesitate–though he does not necessarily stand opposed to you, his guns speak first. By the way, his favorite eye mask was made in Lungmen.
enemy_1284_sgprst.ability:
Gradually increases Blood Debt
Attacks have global range when Asset Liquidation is active
Attacks using Ammo decrease the target's DEF. Ammo capacity: 10

enemy_1280_sgmag.name: Famiglia Caster
enemy_1280_sgmag.desc: For Famiglia-trained Casters, their Originium Arts are the basis of their standing within the famiglia. Though these Casters have fairly mediocre Arts, they at least are effective at inciting hatred.
enemy_1280_sgmag.ability:
Attacks two targets simultaneously.
Can stop attacking to continually increase Blood Debt

enemy_1056_ganwar_2.name: Elite Brawler
enemy_1056_ganwar_2.desc: Exceptionally dangerous combatants who are even more destructive than normal Brawlers. Only the most heavily-armored Operators can withstand their blows.

relics.name: Featured Canned Meat
relics.desc: For travelers on a long journey, the convenience of 'Ready to Eat' is often more important than taste.

relics.name: Seaweed Salad

relics.usage: +1 Squad Size Limit, all friendly units gain +1 ASPD

relics.name: Orange Storm

relics.usage: +1 Squad Size Limit, all friendly units gain +1% ATK

relics.name: Screaming Cherry
relics.desc: A Mama John's candy product. Though the niche vinegar-pickled cherry flavor can't compete with the best-sellers in popularity, there have always been a small group of loyal and dedicated consumers. Rumor has it that one of Mama John's directors loves this flavor.
relics.usage: +2 Squad Size Limit, all friendly units gain +2% ATK

relics.name: Coffee Plains Coffee Candy
relics.desc: Dossoles' famous coffee-flavored candy product. Has real caffeine added, to keep you wide awake from clock-in to overtime.
relics.usage: +2 Squad Size Limit, all friendly units gain +2 ASPD

relics.name: Pitt's Assorted Fruits
relics.desc: Pitt's assorted fruit candies compete with Mama John's line of products in the sweets market with a rich taste and superb cost-effectiveness. Muelsyse's favorite.
relics.usage: +3 Squad Size Limit, all friendly units gain +3% ATK, DEF, and HP

relics.name: Topographical Map

relics.name: Conch of Divine Whispers
relics.desc: Sound it, and gods you've never seen or even heard of will answer your call. Actually, it's just a hollow conch shell.
relics.usage: +1 Deployment Limit, all friendly units gain +4% HP

relics.name: Night-Whispers in the Forest
relics.desc: A special aromatherapy set prepared for field operators by the Convalescent Garden, consisting of fifteen herbal extracts in 172 different combinations. When the wind wends into wooded vales, all creatures lower their voices, and one can find respite.
relics.usage: +2 Deployment Limit, all friendly units gain +6% DEF

relics.name: Church Alms Meal Voucher
relics.desc: In the declining coastal towns of Iberia, certain churches will provide alms in the form of meals, which their believers can redeem using vouchers. As for how these vouchers are distributed, that is a secret.
relics.usage: +2 Deployment Limit, all friendly units gain +6% HP

relics.name: Antiquated Sheet Music
relics.desc: A tattered piece of sheet music. The notes can no longer be clearly read. No one knows for certain what story this piece was meant to tell.
relics.usage: Hope +4

relics.name: Letter of Termination Contract
relics.desc: You can break free of this troupe with just one autograph.
relics.usage: Hope +4

relics.name: Banshee's Kiss

relics.usage: Hope +8

relics.name: Hot Water Kettle
relics.desc: Some people often use the hot water kettle in the Rhodes Island Office to cook instant noodles in the middle of the night. That's not a very healthy lifestyle...
relics.usage: Max Life Points +2; Hope +2

relics.name: Extra-Pungent Coffee Beans
relics.desc: Coffee growers feed their beans to a rare, unusual-smelling breed of fowlbeast before extracting and processing them from its excrement. The unique aroma produced by the beast's gastric acid fermentation triples the price of the coffee beans.

relics.name: Blue Silk Scarf
relics.desc: A lady's elegant scarf. Her appearance is a sign that it is safe here.
relics.usage: Hope +2, Squad Size Limit +1

relics.name: Red Bow Tie
relics.desc: The first present Phantom gave Miss.Christine. She is really fond of it.
relics.usage: Hope +2, Deployment Limit +1

relics.desc: An old music box. The music does not play when the box is opened, nor does the figure inside show any signs it is about to move. There is not a peep, and no one is breaking out in dance. Before she begins her performances with Phantom, the lead actress stares blankly into the music box.
relics.usage: Hope +4, Deployment Limit +1

relics.name: Originium Iris
relics.desc: A most extravagant bouquet of flowers. The troupe leader has handed flowers like these to the leads during countless curtain calls.

relics.desc: A weird-looking flute. Someone plays it day in and day out.
relics.usage: Hope +4, Squad Size Limit +1

relics.name: Glass Bird
relics.desc: 'In this paradise of mine, the bird will sing forever and ever.'
relics.usage: Hope +4, Squad Size Limit +1

relics.name: Pure Gold Expedition
relics.desc: The regent departed from the wastelands, and markets rose from beneath her dress like sprouts budding in the spring. The road of prosperity connected high mountains and dense forests, following her until she disappeared beyond the cliffs overlooking the western waves. —Ancient Sargon Fairy Tale
relics.usage: Hope +4, Squad Size Limit +1, Deployment Limit +1

relics.name: 'Durin Overground'

relics.usage: +6 Objective Shield

relics.name: Supreme Ring

relics.name: Special Suppressor

relics.name: Proof of Longevity
relics.desc:
A tree branch that has withered and flourished. 
When it is withered, it grows anew. When it is thriving in its fullest, it fades away yet again.

relics.name: Swaddled Pegasus
relics.desc: May it, reborn, never have its wings broken again.

relics.name: Swaddled Baize

relics.name: Designer's Ruler

relics.usage: All friendly units have +15% Physical Dodge

relics.name: 'Arts Killer'

relics.name: Dancer's Bracelets

relics.name: Rock Horn

relics.name: Timeworn Poetry Strips

relics.name: Woodblock Prints

relics.name: Three Feet To All
relics.desc: An ancient Yanese movable type printing press. A noble uses words as weapons, while villains... there was once a time when the printing house discovered the word block for 'not' was stolen right before they went to print a work, and the rebuttal text's meaning changed entirely, leaving one unsure whether to cry or not.
relics.usage: After Operators use an ammo-type skill, +100 ASPD for 15 second

relics.name: 'Yanese Dictionary'
relics.desc: Yan's first ever common dictionary, compiled by a civilian writer after over a decade of work. The editor often sighed over how thin the volumes were despite the amount of text, and dedicated a tomb to rare characters that could not be included or recorded.

relics.name: 'Collection of Elegance'

relics.name: 'Blademace'
relics.desc: A sword lodged in a stone. Was someone bored enough to do this?
relics.usage: All Operators have +3 Deployment Cost, but +50% ATK, DEF, and HP

relics.name: Crown of the Red Sun
relics.desc: He gave the crown He loved to His Liberi child. The Liberi accepted the crown, and with it, the daylight. So the Liberi soared above the mountaintops, and from then on the land knew no night.

relics.name: Night Shawl

relics.usage: Ground Operators deal 300% damage the first time they hit each enemy

relics.name: False Wings
relics.desc: “There's one last leaf left on that tree. We can make it through this winter...”
relics.usage: When an allied Operator defeats an enemy, they gain Camouflage for 3 seconds

relics.name: 'Thirst to Bite'
relics.desc: Fresh blood only makes them more frenzied. Where are they? Everywhere.
relics.usage: When an allied Operator defeats an enemy, they gain +100 ASPD for 2 seconds

relics.name: Strange-Scented Horn
relics.desc: A broken-off horn giving off an exciting smell—it seems to have fallen off during a fight between two male creatures in the Forest. Conflict is always addictive.

relics.name: Bloodthirsty Pincer Beast

relics.usage: When an allied Operator defeats an enemy, they restore 10% of their Max HP

relics.name: 'Sanctuary'
relics.desc: Their sweat falls like the Forest's rain, but luckily they have the leaves that kept off the rain to shade them from the blazing sun.
relics.usage: Ranged Operators immediately gain a Barrier equal to 100% of their Max HP on deployment

relics.name: Grower's Insurance Policy
relics.desc: A densely printed insurance policy, but its terms only apply if the insured suffers no accident—luckily, they can't read it anyway.
relics.usage: If an allied Operator takes no damage for 5 seconds, they gain a Barrier equal to 20% of their Max HP

relics.name: Tactical Vest
relics.desc: “I think I could use a few more pockets. I need somewhere to tuck my mom's photo.”
relics.usage: Allied Operators deal 140% damage while they have a Barrier

relics.name: Blessed Rebirth

relics.name: Bound by Others

relics.name: Bloodstained Dictionary

relics.name: Liquid Fertilizer

relics.name: Spicy Cocoa

relics.name: Painkillers

relics.name: Skyrocket Originium Slug

relics.name: Ground Blaster

relics.name: Soaring Wings

relics.name: Serpent Molt

relics.name: Tianshi's Silk Pouch

relics.name: Fire in the Ice

relics.name: Valley Rite

relics.name: Special Ops Riot Shield

relics.name: Hound Coffee

relics.name: Arena VIP Ticket

relics.name: Golden Plains

relics.name: Special Ops Footage

relics.desc: No matter how hard fate hits you, just take it in.

relics.usage: Gain the Natural Object <Dry Moss Ball> until your Parts Box is full

relics.name: Fellow Traveler
relics.desc: “You're one of us now. Let's get used to each other's scent.”
relics.usage: -50% Originium Ingot cost to recruit at Emergency Aid nodes; Emergency Aid Operators gain +40% HP, ATK, and DEF

relics.name: Ill-Fated Firestick
relics.desc: The 'Residents' wave their clubs and stones, not yet knowing they're no match for the smoking stick.
relics.usage: When fighting 'Residents', enemies have -40% HP, and after winning, all Operators permanently gain +10 ASPD

relics.name: Hunter's Brand
relics.desc: This isn't the Beastlord's fear—only a moment's respite It has granted you.
relics.usage: Hound Proto has -50% ATK; allies gain +10 RES for each stack of 【Detection Vanguard】

relics.name: Source Private Key
relics.desc: A precious access card. Remember, it bends to your will.
relics.usage: Immediately gain 99 Originium Ingots; plays a special role in certain events

relics.name: Blackflow Forest Notes
relics.desc: A notebook added to again and again; the different handwriting on its pages shows it has changed hands many times. It seems forever to be waiting for its next chronicler.
relics.usage: Each new type of node explored adds 1 stack; each stack increases the chance of obtaining Collectibles after operations

relics.name: Basic IoT Terminal
relics.desc: A terminal said to connect all things. Being of one mind with everything is no longer a problem. Don't you want to know what your fridge is thinking?
relics.usage: Gain 【Advanced IoT Terminal】 after exploring 2 Rogue Traders or Secluded Traders

relics.name: Advanced IoT Terminal
relics.desc: A modified terminal whose connection range has grown exponentially. Just raise the antenna to experience being of one mind instantly!
relics.usage: After deployment, an Operator links to one Operator within attack range with an Advanced IoT Terminal; enemies touching the terminal are halted and take Arts damage equal to 50% of the combined ATK of all linked Operators every 0.5 seconds

relics.name: Plant Sap
relics.desc: A simple potion made from the sap of trees in the Blackflow Forest. It can mask your own scent.
relics.usage: Gain 【Hound Sap】 after completing 1 【Chase Hunt】 operation

relics.name: Hound Sap
relics.desc: Plant sap mixed with Hound blood. It masks your own scent as much as possible.
relics.usage: Other Operators within an Operator's attack range gain Camouflage and +10% ATK (stackable)

relics.name: Remembrance
relics.desc: Following the Blackflow, I will return to the still-warm swaddling cloth—to the old days when this land could still be called an 'infant'.
relics.usage: When entering the next zone, you re-enter the current zone instead; this Collectible then loses its effect

relics.name: Rappel Raid Rig
relics.desc: The Columbian military's latest mobile gear lets special forces drop from the sky and strike key strategic targets in an instant! “We can solve every problem on this land this way—it's amazing!”
relics.usage: Allied Operators have -50% Redeployment Time; on deployment, they deal Physical damage equal to 1000% of their ATK to 1 random enemy and enemies in the 8 surrounding tiles

relics.name: Register of Grudges
relics.desc: It belonged to a nameless Yan swordsman. “Always one short.”
relics.usage: Allied Operators gain +2% ATK, plus a permanent +0.2% for each enemy defeated (up to +200%)

relics.name: Sand Table α
relics.desc: Special information from the Melander Foundation, with a very high classification level. The area shown on the sand table looks extremely hard to penetrate; perhaps she can only be found after pinpointing her again with clues from the other side.
relics.usage: Allied units' Deployment Cost +2; leads your exploration in a different direction; holding 【Sand Table β】 as well reveals the location of the Source-Tier Cube

relics.name: Sand Table β
relics.desc: Special information from the Coalition Government, with a very high classification level. The area shown on the sand table looks extremely hard to penetrate; perhaps she can only be found after pinpointing her again with clues from the other side.
relics.usage: Allied units' Deployment Cost +3; leads your exploration in a different direction; holding 【Sand Table α】 as well reveals the location of the Source-Tier Cube

relics.name: Heartbeat Beacon
relics.desc: A heart under constant monitoring, seemingly draining your strength. When tuned to a certain direction, it begins to beat faintly.
relics.usage: All enemies have +20% HP and allied units have -40% HP; leads your exploration in a different direction

relics.name: Shoot Down the 'Gods'
relics.desc: Log: Intrusion by an unconfirmed anomalous entity; unexpected error. Destruction of Residents and structures detected, severely detrimental to further development. Prioritize keeping the Utopia running as planned and intercept the target.
relics.usage: At a special node, you can keep 'Bolívar, Core of the Crux' from destroying 'Decrepit Hulk' the first time it unleashes 'Maw of Calamity'

relics.name: Extinguish the 'Light'
relics.desc: Log: Intrusion by an unconfirmed anomalous entity; unexpected error. Rampant unnatural disasters detected, severely detrimental to further development. Prioritize keeping the Utopia running as planned and intercept the target.
relics.usage: At a special node, you can reduce the damage of 'Bolívar, Core of the Crux''s 'Maw of Calamity'

relics.name: Burn Down 'Civilization'
relics.desc: Log: Intrusion by an unconfirmed anomalous entity; unexpected error. Interference with cognitive foundations detected, severely detrimental to further development. Prioritize keeping the Utopia running as planned and intercept the target.
relics.usage: At a special node, you can stop 'Bolívar, Core of the Crux''s 'Maw of Calamity' from sealing off the standby deployment area

relics.name: 'Civilight Eterna'
relics.desc: A small, black crown.
relics.usage: All enemies take +150% True damage.

relics.name: 'Glory Pack'
relics.desc: A special betting method set up by the organizers for the duration of the knight competition season. Choose from a variety of complementary betting packages to minimize your losses on any particular match.
relics.usage: When an Operator is defeated, it will Stun all enemies in the four adjacent tiles for 6 seconds

relics.name: 'End of Times'
relics.desc: As long as a new cycle has not been reached, there is still time to fix your mistakes.
relics.usage: For one time only, if you would fail any battle other than the final battle of the area or a Leader battle, you instead gain +1 Life Point and advance to the next step instead of concluding the exploration

relics.name: 'Little Gran Faro'
relics.desc: The illumination device produced after reverse engineering the Eye of Iberia. It is powerful enough to penetrate layers of dark clouds, as well as temporarily repel powerful enemies.
relics.usage: Deals Stun on all enemy units for 5 seconds every time an enemy unit enters the Protection Objective

relics.name: 'Memories of The Shard'
relics.desc: 'It has pierced Victoria's heart, and is watching the empire bleed.'
relics.usage: Deals 5000 True damage to all enemy units every time an enemy unit enters the Objective Point

relics.name: HR Bronze Seal

relics.usage: Recruit a random 5-star Operator that is automatically Promoted

relics.name: Doctor Silver Seal
relics.desc: Emblem that you instructed to be sent out at the right time before you left. Your selected Operator has joined the field mission at the camp, while handing it back to you the way you left it.

relics.name: Rainbow Jar
relics.desc: The Sami usually keep this carefully where the rainbow comes down, using it to ward off unpredictable disasters, natural and man-made alike.
relics.usage: Whenever an enemy enters the Objective Point, the Redeployment Time of a random Operator waiting to be re-deployed is reduced to 0

relics.name: Coin Geists

scraps.name: Seed
scraps.usage: Can be cultivated at the Secluded Trader for rewards
scraps.desc: What is it nurturing?

scraps.name: Blood Mushroom
scraps.usage: Appraisal value +2 after each operation
scraps.desc: Please, feast to your heart's content—until you're the one served on the plate.

scraps.name: Mist Tumbleweed
scraps.usage: Appraisal value +1 each time you reveal node information
scraps.desc: Swept along by the mist, it drifts ever farther from the land and its roots.

scraps.name: Echo Corn
scraps.usage: Appraisal value +3 each time you recruit an Operator
scraps.desc: Every kernel of sweet talk is clear and plump.

scraps.name: Sea Spray
scraps.usage: Appraisal value changes randomly after each move
scraps.desc: Nature brings about change, and thought colors it, so that living things may proudly proclaim their own freedom.

scraps.name: Frost Crystal Tree
scraps.usage: Appraisal value +4 after each perfect operation; breaks after an imperfect operation
scraps.desc: Before the sunlight pierces its innards, it shows off its unmelted delicacy.

scraps.name: Prolific Moss
scraps.usage: Immediately gain 3 <Dry Moss Ball> on acquisition; appraisal value +1 each time you obtain Parts
scraps.desc: It creeps over soil, trees, dreams, and growth.

scraps.name: Dry Moss Ball
scraps.usage: A Natural Object with a low appraisal value
scraps.desc: And then comes rot, withering, despair, and death.

scraps.name: Plank Vine
scraps.usage: Appraisal value +4 each time you obtain Parts
scraps.desc: It grabs hold of its own kind and refuses to let go.

scraps.name: Homesick Fruit
scraps.usage: Appraisal value -2 after each move
scraps.desc: Blinded by praise, it starts life's countdown with its own hands.

scraps.name: Radiant Truffle
scraps.usage: A Natural Object with a high appraisal value
scraps.desc: Had it not been dug up and tasted, it would never have deserved such an honor.

scraps.name: Cage Controller
scraps.usage: Has a special use in Encounters
scraps.desc: A brief silence doesn't mean true control.

scraps.name: Scrapped Wheel
scraps.usage: Once loaded, allows moving to any node within 2 tiles in a straight line (1 move)
scraps.desc: Keep breaking it, and it will no longer be definable.

scraps.name: Scrapped Prosthetic
scraps.usage: Once loaded, allows moving to any node among the 8 adjacent tiles (1 move)
scraps.desc: War gave it to the survivors, and it will carry the survivors back to the battlefield.

scraps.name: Standard Engine
scraps.usage: Once loaded, allows moving to any node among the 8 adjacent tiles (3 moves)
scraps.desc: Can you hear what's missing after the roar?

scraps.name: Heavy Spring
scraps.usage: Once loaded, allows moving to any node within the surrounding 12 tiles without spending Action Points; cannot be carried to the next area (1 move)
scraps.desc: The first step of spreading out, the last step of a life.

scraps.name: Air-Cushion Base
scraps.usage: Once loaded, allows moving to any node within the surrounding 12 tiles (2 moves)
scraps.desc: A thick yet fragile air cushion that blocks out all unpleasantness.

scraps.name: Prototype Exoskeleton
scraps.usage: Once loaded, allows moving to any node within 3 tiles in a straight line (2 moves)
scraps.desc: The richest poison is called 'beyond one's power'.

scraps.name: Little Ba'jie
scraps.usage: Once loaded and used, randomly teleports you to a non-combat node without spending Action Points; cannot be carried to the next area (1 move)
scraps.desc: Don't ask why it's here or where it's going. It's just here to play.

scraps.name: Disposable Jetpack
scraps.usage: Once loaded, allows moving to any node without spending Action Points (1 move)
scraps.desc: Those who reach up to grasp the sky never look back at the land burned to cinders.

scraps.name: Old Mother's Snowmelt
scraps.usage: Once loaded, allows moving to any non-combat node, gaining +2 Hope after the move (1 move)
scraps.desc: The last wish of a Beastlord before It passed.

scraps.name: Kannot's Tentacle
scraps.usage: Once loaded, allows moving to any trader node, gaining +4 Originium Ingots after each move (2 moves)
scraps.desc: Its irregular wriggling mirrors a rapidly fluctuating price.

scraps.name: Structural Principle
scraps.usage: Once loaded, allows moving to any node (3 moves)
scraps.desc: Before its energy runs out, it carries all things out of the wilds.

scraps.name: 'Simple Remote'
scraps.usage: Once loaded, allows moving to any node among the 8 adjacent tiles without spending Action Points, gaining +3 Action Points after the move (1 move)
scraps.desc: Ironically, the machine that once controlled the herds is about to remotely control the explorer's fate.

scraps.name: Blank Model Bird
scraps.usage: Moving to a combat node with a Crafted Good loaded grants allied units +50 ASPD for that battle and 1 random Collectible afterward (can activate once)
scraps.desc: Before Originium's taint, its wings blotted out the sky.

scraps.name: Blank Model Dog
scraps.usage: Moving to a non-combat node with a Crafted Good loaded grants 1 random Collectible (can activate once)
scraps.desc: Before Originium's taint, its roar echoed across the land.

scraps.name: Blank Model Fish
scraps.usage: Moving to any node with a Crafted Good loaded grants 3 Objective Shield (can activate once)
scraps.desc: Before Originium's taint, its tail fin churned the seas.

scraps.name: Painted Liberi
scraps.usage: Moving to a combat node with a Crafted Good loaded grants allied units +35 ASPD for that battle
scraps.desc: Originium granted them imagination and spirituality.

scraps.name: Painted Perro
scraps.usage: Moving to a Wish Fulfilled node with a Crafted Good loaded grants 1 random Collectible
scraps.desc: Originium granted them patience and waiting.

scraps.name: Painted Aegir
scraps.usage: Moving to a Lost and Found node with a Crafted Good loaded grants 2 random Collectibles
scraps.desc: Originium granted them silence and development.
