endings.name: Forced Reboot
endings.desc: 'You' will keep trying, won't you? Error cause: A child thread hit a fatal error due to insufficient stack space; process terminated.
cond: Without holding the Collectible 「Heartbeat Beacon」, clear floor 5's Dreadful Foe 「Never at Peace」 or its variant 「Pain Shall Subside」 to achieve this ending (any difficulty).

endings.name: Dimensional Reconstruction
endings.desc: She will always be here waiting for 'you'. Error cause: A debugger has been attached to the target process; the session will terminate shortly.
endings.change: The Usurper quietly awaits the Seeker's arrival.
cond: Achieving the ending 「Forced Reboot」 first unlocks the related choices and Collectibles.

Obtain 「Sand Table α」 or 「Sand Table β」. α comes from choosing 【Hired by Melander】 in the floor 2–4 Encounter 「The Informant」 (allied Deployment Cost +2 afterward); β is sold for 1 Originium Ingot by the Rogue Trader on floors 1–3 (allied Deployment Cost +3 afterward).

Upon reaching floor 5, 3 Prophecy nodes appear — two are 「Curiosity and Death」 and one is 「Inside the Peep Show」. Holding both Sand Table α and β automatically marks the location of 「Inside the Peep Show」; if you enter the wrong one, you can pay resources to mark the real location or take 1 Collectible.

Choosing 【Protect the evidence—seize those machines!】 in 「Inside the Peep Show」 turns that node into the Dreadful Foe 「Chaotic Source-Tier Theory」, where you fight 「Source-Tier Cube」 and 「Lorenz, Error of Perturbation」.
Clear floor 5 through this battle without holding the 「Heartbeat Beacon」 to achieve this ending.

endings.name: Entanglement, Harmony
endings.desc: They've found 'you'. Error cause: A conflict occurred during a write attempt; the request was terminated because the hub address could not be resolved.
cond: Achieving the ending 「Forced Reboot」 first unlocks the related choices and Collectibles.

At a Scout node on floors 2–4 (Encounter 「The Untrodden Tree」), choose 【Seek out the tree's roots】 to dispatch 1 Operator. When they return on the next floor, instead of a promotion they bring back 2 Hope and the Collectible 「Heartbeat Beacon」 (allied units -40% HP, all enemies +20% HP).

(Optional) Before floor 6, you can gather 3 Collectibles that make the final battle easier — 「Shoot Down the 'Gods'」 from 【Offer all your wealth】 in the floor 2–4 Encounter 「Village of Tears」; 「Burn Down 'Civilization'」 from 【Restore 'Civilization'】 at a Lost and Found node; and 「Extinguish the 'Light'」 as an optional reward after the 「Futile Autopsy」 battle.

Clear the floor 5 battle while holding the 「Heartbeat Beacon」 to enter floor 6, 'Where the Headwaters Meet'. Face 「Bolívar, Core of the Crux」 in the Dreadful Foe 「Malformation」 — before entering, you can submit the Collectibles above at the 「Attunement Ritual」 to weaken the enemy.
Clear 「Malformation」 to achieve this ending (any difficulty).

encounters.title: Homesick at Heart
encounters.desc: The sound of crying catches your attention. In a forest where any strange thing can happen, you'd rather ignore it, but the sound grows louder and louder until it gets on your nerves. You track down the source: a dog with tear-filled eyes. You loudly ask why it's crying, and learn that it hasn't been back to its hometown in a long time—and has gotten lost right at its own front door.

choices.title: Chase it away
choices.desc: I'm lost too! I can't look after you!

next.desc: The dog fidgets and refuses to leave. You don't want to get tangled up with this annoying fellow—it's time to teach it a lesson.

choices.title: Comfort it
choices.desc: Better not to go looking for trouble

next.desc: You offer it a few simple words of comfort and treat it as a rest stop. What happens next is up to it.

choices.title: Drive it off by force
choices.desc: Encounter a special battle

encounters.title: A Good Deal
encounters.desc: A rat blocks your way. It wants to buy everything you have on you—flashlight, protective suit, employer records, even an experience you were planning to take to your grave. Its words lack any trace of courtesy, as if it has already decided you'll never make it out of this forest, and the only thing left for you to do is send some compensation money home.

choices.title: Make it shut up
choices.desc: What rotten luck! I'd say you're the one who can't get out of the forest!

next.desc: Seeing that you're up to no good, it deftly pulls a weapon from behind its back. It seems plenty of people have already reached acquisition agreements with it, whether willingly or not.

choices.title: Pretend you didn't hear
choices.desc: Better not to go looking for trouble

next.desc: You'd rather not deal with it, so you leave. Profit can drive a merchant to do business anywhere, and the strange Blackflow Forest is no exception. Perhaps it will learn a lesson here—or perhaps it will make a killing.

encounters.title: Ducktopia
encounters.desc: In the forest, strange little animals roam in small groups, but the eeriest sight by far is a duck standing by a black pond, watching identical ducks crawl out of the water one after another, shaking out their feathers. You approach the Black Pond to find out what on earth is happening here, but a silent bear blocks your way.

choices.title: Talk back
choices.desc: Duck, aren't you a little full of yourself?

next.desc: Your heckling doesn't interest the duck, but the bear in front of you seems to have received an order—you are not a potential customer, so there's no need to be polite to you.

choices.title: Deliberately stir up trouble
choices.desc: Encounter a tough special battle

next.desc: The Originium Ingots in your hand catch the interest of the lead duck and the flock. Now you have thoroughly disrupted the Ducktopia that was just taking shape. Without even ordering his underlings, the lead duck pulls his hat low with a wing and swoops at you at full speed! Business isn't the only thing he's mastered.

choices.title: A mere thug!
choices.desc: Encounter a special battle

choices.title: Uninterested
choices.desc: Better not to go looking for trouble

next.desc: On your way out, you walk to the other side of the Black Pond and find daily necessities, wallets, and IOUs for loans from the duck scattered about. A line of human footprints leads into the Black Pond, and a line of duck's webbed prints appears on the opposite bank. In an instant you understand everything, and start feeling grateful that you didn't interfere with this 'special' debt-collection operation.

encounters.desc: A caravan swaggers into view in front of you. With no competitors, these guys are raking it in. A duck sits in the truck's passenger seat, directing the rat at the wheel to honk at you, demanding that you make way for the commercial empire about to rise.

choices.desc: Sit down where you are

encounters.title: The Fairy of the Lake
encounters.desc: In the woods, you hear gentle singing. Its source sits on a rock in the middle of a shallow lake, holding a bouquet of vivid flowers, the water beneath her glittering. She beckons you over.

choices.title: Go take a look
choices.desc: What on earth is going on?

next.desc: “Many wish to find the treasure in the lake, but they always lack sincerity.” The fairy stirs the water with her hand, sending out ripples and revealing a shining bracelet on her wrist. “Are you willing to show your devotion?”

choices.title: Ignore her
choices.desc: Better not to go looking for trouble

next.desc: There are too many inexplicable things in this forest; even what you see with your own eyes isn't necessarily real. Without another glance at her, you hurry away.

choices.title: Show your sincerity
choices.desc: Lose 1 Originium Ingot

next.desc: She fishes a lodestone out of the lake; it doesn't look worth much. “Perhaps we could throw it back into the lake and find something better. Are you willing to show your devotion?”

choices.title: You won't fool me
choices.desc: This is way too suspicious

next.desc: You see the beautiful fairy's reflection clearly: a monster resembling both a snake and a scorpion. The lake has revealed her true face, and she can no longer deceive you.

Like you, I've been tracking down the source of an unidentified electrical signal, but I'm running low on supplies and have to pull back first. I'll hand over every lead I have. I hope you can finish the mission for me.”

“It's no small feat to make it this far.” It seems to crack a barely perceptible smile. “Go any further, and you may face dangers beyond imagining—but for an explorer, that may also be a rare opportunity. I have some supplies here that I can't pack up and take with me. They're yours.”
“You shouldn't have come here.” It looks at you gravely. “You don't understand what danger they've put you in. Turn back early; I won't make things difficult for you.”

scenes.desc: You embrace the lignum vitae, and it embraces you in return. Your consciousness seems to climb onto that nonexistent swing, soaring high and falling again and again. The feeling of hanging in midair frightens you a little, yet you can't help feeling excited and joyful. Everything here vanishes, and all that remains beside you is... a camera?

You decide to use the materials on hand to build a swing here. Its phantom image seems to have existed in your mind from the very start, and all you have to do is fill in its shape with your hands. When you finish, you seem to hear a burst of innocent laughter—then everything vanishes, and all that remains beside you is... a camera?

Comparing the pixel kitten printed on the card with the pattern carved into the trunk, you seem to understand something. The pixel kitten jumps out of the card and merges with the pattern on the trunk. You seem to see a young girl laughing on a swing, but then everything here vanishes, and all that remains beside you is... a camera?

Worried that you might still be surrounded by hounds here, you take out the Cage Controller to rein in the unknown danger. The device's readings drop to zero, and your consciousness gradually fades. You see the carved kitten smiling, and you feel as if you were inside the lignum vitae, your whole body brimming with strength—you can go farther. You firmly believe it.

The rich, smoky fragrance of the lignum vitae mingles with the scent of flowers, bringing you a calm you've never felt before. You touch the kitten carved into the trunk; its smiling eyes seem to encourage you to explore a little further. Perhaps that is the meaning of its existence here.

scenes.desc: You yank out the clothes that were pinned underneath; Blackflow and bloodstains crisscross them. Just as you're about to take a closer look, the clothes suddenly cling to your skin. With a stabbing pain in your palm, you feel the world spin.

Once cut, the little flower quickly withers and shrivels. As you examine the dried flower, your finger is suddenly pricked. The calyx has bitten you, and the petals swell full again, their ocher-red blades dripping like blood. You shake your hand hard but can't shake it off, and a wave of dizziness washes over you.

You cut the vines entangling the clothes and flowers. The sap oozing from the cuts makes your skin faintly itch. You don't even notice the twitching vines wrapping around your arm, straining to constrict as if to squeeze you dry. Your vision begins to blur.
This pile of things is far too eerie. Whatever you do, don't get tangled up in it—save your strength and leave as quickly as possible.

scenes.desc: It's a somewhat old doll, and you can tell its original owner cherished it. Why is it here? Was it lost by accident? You smooth the cloud-beast doll's fluff, and the fibers shedding from it make you sneeze in spite of yourself.

Perhaps this was some child's bedtime doll; it must have heard many familiar lullabies. You clear your throat and hum a familiar tune, and the cloud-beast doll's mouth stops moving, as if it had never invited you at all.

The horse's lips quiver as it spits something out: “You'd never guess what customers with a collecting hobby are buying. What matters isn't the true value of the goods or the purchase price—it's how you package them to look priceless. A merchant lives by a silver tongue, doesn't he?”

The horse's lips quiver as it spits something out: “I once met a customer with an eye as discerning as yours, who wanted to bring back some local specialties from every new place—things that are commonplace in one land but rare treasures in another. A merchant profits from information gaps, doesn't he?”

The stone mill is even heavier than you imagined, and it takes a lot of effort to push, but even so, you're much faster than the sloth. The contract is fulfilled. You see the sloth raise its hand and point its long claws in a certain direction.

You decide to put an end to this absurd contract and overturn the stone mill with all your strength. The rabbit and the sloth tumble to the ground, and the millstone rolls off deep into the woods. Following the track it leaves behind, you unexpectedly find a shortcut.
Ignoring the stomping rabbit and the pitiful sloth, you turn and leave.

choices.title: Push the giant wheeled wooden barrel
choices.desc: If you hold the Four-Leaf Clover Fossil, gain 1 Collectible
choices.cn: 推装着轮子的巨大木桶

visitors.name: Fearless
visitors.desc: Because they were once loved, and so learned how to love.

scenes.desc: A butterfly flaps its wings and unexpectedly leads a mother to a white grave she could never have set foot in.
scenes.cn: 蝴蝶振翅，意外地将一名母亲引至她本不可能踏足的白色坟墓。

scenes.desc: The pressure plummets and dark clouds hang low. Something is always about to be born into this world.
scenes.cn: 气压骤降，乌云低垂，总有一些东西要降生到世上。

scenes.desc: A storm has already formed, and in the end it will sweep away everything in its path.
scenes.cn: 一场暴风已然形成，它终究要席卷路径上的一切。

visitors.name: Keep Going?
visitors.desc: Don't be silly. Rain on the road is perfectly normal.

scenes.desc: Death isn't in her near-term plans.
scenes.cn: 她近期的计划里没有死亡。

scenes.desc: She climbs the highest mountain in Bolívar.
scenes.cn: 她登上玻利瓦尔最高的山。

scenes.desc: She looks out the window. Her homeland, like her ideals, is gone and never coming back.
scenes.cn: 她望向窗外，祖国和理想一样一去不返。
